However to create these fake images, the quality of these images should be compromised and this can also make them easily identifiable as fake image. So, here StyleGANS will be used as another implementation of GANS. StyleGANS is not only used for improving the quality of these images but also it helps us to increase fakeness of the images. This project uses the CelebA dataset from Kaggle to train the models.

articleTitle: Speed Control of Synchronous Motor using Neurofuzzy Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Synchronous motors have a significant role in power houses as they may be used for power factor correction. In applications where a constant speed is required, these motors may be used. It runs at constant speed synchronized with the frequency of applied 3 phase ac. The present article addresses the speed control of a synchronous motor. Having identified its transfer function model in MATLAB on basis of raw data, the PI and Neurofuzzy control systems are developed for it using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Two-stage CMOS LCD Buffer Operational Amplifier with Additional Load Capacitance
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The research paper represents comparative analysis of MOSFET parameters such as Delay, Phase Margin, Power consumption and Unity Gain Bandwidth (UGB) between pre-layout and post-Layout simulation of the two stage CMOS LCD buffer operational amplifier with additional load capacitance. The op-amp provides a gain of 84.43dB and a phase margin of 66 degrees, bandwidth of 286 kHz for a load of 300f F. The power dissipation for the op-amp is 2.722µW and UGB is 296.9MHz for post layout simulation. The two stage CMOS LCD buffer operational amplifier circuit is built and simulated using Cadence Virtuoso Tool with a 65nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Cosmetic Suggestion System Using Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Nowadays, cosmetics play a significant role in personal appearance. Choosing the best skin care product is becoming increasingly complicated. As a result, a predictive approach is developed that gives a clear understanding of which product is best for a certain skin type. An AI algorithm is utilized to solve this problem since it works well with vast amount of unstructured data and produces promising results. Convolutional Neural Networks are used in the suggested system (CNN). The model is trained from a dataset that was scrapped from the internet consists of four classes of skin types i.e normal, dry, oily and combinational. The CNN model is built utilizing the packages in Python 3 such as Numpy, OpenCV, Matplotlib, TensorFlow, Keras and Sklearn. This method is created by training and testing the model to establish accuracy. The products suitable for each class of skin types are combined in a file. After detecting the skin type, the suitable products for those skin type is fetched from that file. As a result, best composition of cosmetic products are suggested for suitable skin types. The goal is to achieve high accuracy and detect the skin type using the defined training model.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Detection of Hand Arthritis using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Arthritis is becoming a more common disease across the globe. Different types of arthritis diseases are affecting the human body, they are osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and psoriatic arthritis, within which the osteoarthritis is considered as the most common disease. The recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) will eventually result in a fully automated workflow, which outperforms human performance. Advanced neural networks can recognize objects present in the images and further the objects will be categorized more precisely and quickly than humans. This research study has attempted to implement the machine learning technique to classify and categorize the different stages of hand arthritis in patients. This research study also investigates how Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is used for the detection and classification of Osteoarthritis in a descriptive and comparative manner. Recognizing the precise segment of RA is a difficult task because human abilities will frequently limit the methods applied. The Convolutional neural network (CNN) is used to recognize multiple examples of hand reputation. The Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has the ability to recognize human traits and is anticipating the sophistication of hand radiographs from a large dataset. As a result, a research discussion of various arthritis detection techniques, feature extraction techniques, and classification schemes has been conducted.

articleTitle: Prediction of Bankruptcy of a company using machine learning techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Bankruptcy prediction is an important modern technique because it helps not only the policy makers but the investors and all concerned people so they can take all necessary steps to prevent or to reduce the after effects of bankruptcy. Companies take a large quantity of loan and when they become bankrupt the entire system of the bank is shattered as it is really tough to get the given money bank. Hence, it is must needed to develop a system that could predict it the company’s bankruptcy and stop the loan. It is observed that the newer machine learning prediction model is outperforming the models of past thirteen years, using relatively small data but this data is still very big and balanced. Some of the machine learning models or techniques are Random Forest, XGBoost, Vector Machines. The main motive of the paper aims to compare the machine learning models which are support vector machine, random forest and XGBoost and give which one performs the best amongst them and give a novel accuracy.

articleTitle: Development of V2V Communication using Light Fidelity
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The present era is leading us to the peak of wireless communication. Taking wireless communication into account, cellular network technologies like Wi-Fi and Bluetooth strike out first. But ecosystem is getting worse day-by-day with the use of these technologies. Hence a greener, faster and more efficient technology is the need of the hour. This is where Li-Fi (i.e., Light Fidelity) comes into play. Li-Fi is a VLC (i.e., Visible Light Communication) Technology that uses light as a medium for communication. Obviously, it is the fastest medium of communication and is eco-friendly one. Combining the V2V and Li-Fi Technologies will drive the future of smart cars to a higher altitude. This project briefs the use of Vehicle to Vehicle (V2V) Communication using Light Fidelity (Li-Fi) to pass data among vehicles in order to prevent traffic jam, accidents, etc. This research work has used Gyro sensor, Ultrasonic sensor, LCD display, LDR sensor, Transmitter and a Receiver of Li-Fi. LEDs as light source.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Various Preprocessing Techniques for brain MRI image
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Nowadays, MRI images of the brain are extremely useful in the medical field for diagnosing various diseases and injuries related to the brain. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain provides high-quality 2D or 3D images of the brain and cerebrum stem utilizing magnetic flux and radio signals. In medical image analysis, it is necessary to perform image preprocessing steps to prepare the image for segmentation and classification. It aids in the improvement of image quality by removing noise effects. This paper focused on a review of various preprocessing methods used in brain MRI images.

articleTitle: Water Hardness Prediction using Fuzzy Subtractive Clustering and GRNN
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Softcomputing methods e. g. Fuzzy Logic, ANN, GA etc. have proven to be very fast and effective techniques for solving the classification and regression problems. They can be very well applied to both linear and non-linear data. The results can be further improved by combining these techniques to build a hybrid model. The present article addresses the anticipation of hardness of water. The prediction models based on the fuzzy subtractive clustering and GRNN (General Regression Neural Network) techniques have been developed in MATLAB using the available raw data pertaining to the water hardness of lake. A comparative analysis is also presented of the developed models.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Flexible Materials for Patch Antennas Operating at 24 GHz ISM Band
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Patch antennas are required to be built on flexible substrates for flexible electronic devices. Flexible electronics require the radiating antennas to be non-rigid. Various such flexible substrates are available for operation at specific frequencies. This paper discusses on the materials used for operation at 24 GHz which is one of the ISM bands used in the high frequency spectrum. A rectangular patch antenna design at 24 GHz is investigated for three different flexible substrate materials, Polyester, Polyethylene terephthalate (PET) and Polyimide with coaxial type of feed and their radiation characteristics are obtained. Polyester substrate provides gain and directivity of 6.9 dB and 7 dB respectively, whereas Polyimide substrate provides gain and directivity of 6.2 dB and 6.7 dB respectively and PET substrate provides gain and directivity of 6.7 dB and 7.1 dB respectively.

articleTitle: Gene Expression Analysis using Particle Swarm Optimization and Machine Learning Algorithms for Diagnosing Liver & Breast Cancer
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Cancer is characterized by tremendous increase in the number of cells which can affect the organs of body. Thanks to the rapid technological advances of recent years, it is now possible to analyze the cellular structure of different types of cancer in a short period of time. DNA microarrays printed microscope slides have thousands of tiny dots in the specified location, each containing a sequence of DNA or a gene. The objective of this paper is to use Particle Swarm Optimization as a transform for increasing the machine learning algorithms such as Quadratic Discriminant Analysis, K Nearest Neighbor Classifier, Random Forest Classifier. Gene expression data related to 358 Liver cancer and 290 Breast cancer subjects are considered in this analysis. Principal Component Analysis used for reducing the dimensionality of data. Notably, Quadratic Discriminant Analysis when used with Particle Swarm Optimization provides the highest Balanced Accuracy score of 96 % for liver cancer data while K Nearest Neighbor classifier along with Particle Swarm Optimization provides the highest Balanced Accuracy score of 91 % for breast cancer data.

articleTitle: Improved Facial Emotion Recognition using Yolo and DeepFace for Music suggestion
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The most ideal characteristic in the human being that differentiates one another is their face. Sometimes Opinion of a person can be estimated from their facial expressions. Emotion recognition is a research area that focuses on human face recognition and estimating the type of emotion expressed. This research study utilizes two well-known algorithms, namely Yoloface and Deepface, wherein the former extracts the face from the live image and the latter classifies the type of emotion expressed by the person. The output of the Deepface algorithm is provided as an input to the music recommendation application. This application plays songs based on the category of emotion predicted by the Deepface algorithm. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Advanced Patient Monitoring and Alert System with Auto Medicine Suggestion using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to observe and supervise the patient's health using a hardware medical kit and a software application. This proposal illustrates the objective of resolving health complaints using present-day technology, the Internet of things (IoT), and Machine Learning. The Patient’s body specifications can be determined concurrently using this system framework. The sensors fetch patient body specifications and hand over the particulars to a microcontroller which forwards that to the cloud. The sufferer can lay eyes on this information with the help of an android application. Distinct decision-making algorithms are made to make it fine and the primary perk of this system is it spontaneously produces the proper prescription based on the vital specifications of the valetudinarian.

articleTitle: Monitoring RO Plant using Virtual HMI and PLC with Visual Programming Tool
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Human machine interface is a link between the machine and the operator. In other words, HMI – Human machine interface is the point of contact to interact and get the status of the process. HMI is used to display the status of inputs and outputs. The process can be monitored continuously without any intervention. HMI has the ability to receive the data from a programmable logic controller. The communication between the industrial controller and human machine interface can be by RS485 or RS232 communication protocol. In this project, a simulation of reverse osmosis process/plant using Delta HMI and Delta PLC is executed. Reverse osmosis plant contains solenoid valves and pumps. The solenoid valves can be operated by AC voltage or DC voltage. The pumps can be turned on and off using contactors. DOPSoft4.0 and ISPSoft3.15 software’s are used to design the components and program.

articleTitle: CMOS Implementation of Multivoltage GPIO Driver
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A meticulous study on design and performance analysis of CMOS General purpose Input Output driver supporting multiple I/O voltage is focused. Smooth processing with multiple voltage levels is achieved for a wider range of frequencies. Design is made using Skywater 130nm process and complete front-end design and analysis is done using Ngspice. The proposed design works for a wider range of frequencies up to 100 MHz.

articleTitle: Advanced Collision Detection Warning System for Enhanced Safety in Highway Driving
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: An Advanced Collision Detection and Warning (ACDW) system for enhancing automotive driver safety during highway driving is presented in this paper. The proposed system uses camera vision for capturing on-road views and the captured images are subsequently processed using an electronics hardware. The overall objective of this work is to conceive a low-cost and portable ACDW system that can continuously monitor on-road views at rapid frame rates using edge computing device hardware and provide advanced warning to the driver for enhanced safety. The main contributions of this work include the ACDW system hardware architecture and the method/image processing algorithm used for detecting critical highway situations. The proposed system has been verified in real-time using a Raspberry PI3 edge computing device and the reported results are compared with other related algorithms.

articleTitle: Common Fault Diagnosis and Elimination of Automobile Air-Conditioning Refrigeration System: based on Smart Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper studies the common troubleshooting and identification process of automobile air conditioning refrigeration systems based on smart sensors. First, it analyzes the automobile air conditioning system through the flexible adjustment of the air humidity, temperature, cleanliness, flow speed and other parameters in the car, which not only strengthens the ride in the car. The environment can also remove or prevent the fog and frost attached to the glass. The automobile air-conditioning refrigeration system has frequent failures. For contemporary people with a faster pace of life, the ability to quickly diagnose and determine the cause of the failure and perform maintenance tests the skills of the auto repair personnel. level.

articleTitle: Discussion on Computer Information Network Security Measures in the Era of Data Autonomy
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The computer information network security problem is not conducive to the development of enterprises, so it is urgent to find preventive measures to deal with the problem. Therefore, this article focuses on analyzing existing security issues, studying preventive measures for computer network security issues, researching preventive measures for computer information network security based on data autonomy, and firstly introduces the meaning, concept and research significance of data autonomy, based on the era of big data, Data autonomy can bring higher convenience; then analyzes computer information network security issues and corresponding preventive measures.

articleTitle: A Wearable Device for Remote Vital Signs Monitoring:A Review Article
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The primary emphasis of modern healthcare services is to ensure the patient comfort. Wearable electronics are wireless devices that may be worn by patients to any place. Recently, different wearable devices are designed and developed to monitor the vital signs such as temperature, blood pressure, oxygen level, and pulse rate. The regular vital sign monitoring plays a crucial role in providing the patients with accurate and effective treatment. Moreover, checking the patient's vital signs on a frequent basis is highly essential to provide a better result and prognosis. Wearable technologies assist people in better understanding their health state. This technology opens up a new way to test the vital signs elsewhere at home, school, office, and so on rather than in a hospital. However, the wearable devices also impose few limitations in the patient's lifestyle or daily routine. Patch monitors, fabric monitors, chest trap monitors, armband monitors, wrist bands, and other sorts of wearable devices are some of the different types of wearable devices in practice. This paper reviews the recent innovations in wearable devices and the effectiveness of remote healthcare monitoring techniques by showcasing their methods, frameworks, comparison, challenges, and future scope.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Printed Planar Compact Broadband Dual Frequency Antenna in FR4 Substrate for Signal Processing Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study proposes a printed compact dual frequency broadband antenna, which can radiate at two resonant frequencies such as 2.1GHz and 5.80 GHz. The proposed antenna is designed in Ansoft Magus CAD EM simulation tool. The material substrate used here is FR4 substrate with εr=2.2, tanδ =0.001, and h =0.254 mm. The operating frequency is designed for ISM band 5G application for performing multi-band switching in mobile phones. The antenna dimension considered here is 23mmX 68mmX 254μm, a compact structure which can be easily embedded in any random area. The simulated output involves simulated parameter values, which are acceptable for fabrication & the testing total gain is 2.17 dBi with VSWR = 2 and Zin= 45Ω.

articleTitle: Research on Community Intelligence Framework based on Emergency Response System Construction
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Based on the existing research, this paper sorts out and summarizes the relevant elements of community emergency management capabilities. In-depth analysis of the status quo of each element of emergency management capability in Sanyuan community. Using the analytic hierarchy process and the questionnaire survey method, analyze the weights, collect data, and then extract the ternary community's emergency support ability f(x), monitoring and early warning ability y(x), information processing ability z(x) and Practices and experiences for reference in terms of early handling capacity, establish a safe community emergency response system, strengthen community emergency coordination capacity by 6.7%, establish a multi-subject cooperation mechanism, increase by 12.3%, increase capital investment, establish a community emergency management guarantee mechanism, strengthen Community emergency cultural construction, improve the public's emergency concept.

articleTitle: Voltage Profile Enhancement in a PV Connected Hybrid Power System using Dynamic Voltage Restorer
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research focuses on improving the voltage profile in a hybrid power system with a PV connection utilising a dynamic voltage restorer. The goal of this work is to raise the system's power quality. Even if voltage sag and swell occur on both the transmission and distribution sides, the issue is only fixed there. A methodical technique is used, assuming the elements required to develop the system. A dynamic voltage restorer that is connected in series recognizes voltage flickering right away and restores high voltage to its original levels. This model's design successfully resolves the voltage flickering issue as well. MATLAB Simulink is used to simulate the results, which clarified the system's significance.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of 32 X 8 Kb Random Access Memory Composed of Reciprocal Magnetic Flux Quanta
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: By 2020, CMOS (complementary metal-oxide semiconductor) technology will be obsolete, and Post Moore law technology will be vying for low-power, high-speed operation. With both speed and energy economy, high-performance computing is in high demand. One of the technologies that will produce high speed and minimal static power dissipation is Reciprocal Quantum Logic (RQL). Instead, then using a DC power supply, RQL employs an AC power supply. To avoid power loss and achieve high speed, a series of reciprocal transmission lines are built between each gate. CMOS technology has been used in a variety of RAM (Random Access Memory) developments. VHDL (VHSIC Hardware Description Language) is used to design a 32 X 8 Kb RAM cell. VHDL is a hardware description language that is used to design EDAs (Electronic Design Automation). To adopt superconductor logic, random access memory cells are first synthesized and then simulated using HDL software, which provides IEEE standards 1076 2002. Power is measured using Xilinx Vivado design suite after implementation and those power is compared to find efficient design

articleTitle: Distributed Computer Solution Design of Tourism English Translation Strategy based on Cloud Real-Time Collaborative System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Aiming at the subjectivity of user evaluation behavior and the sparsiness of data results in a problem that the score prediction result produces errors, a cloud model-based BP neural network score prediction algorithm is proposed. Tourism Foreign Xuan Material Translation Should take readers as a tourist or potential tourist identity; discusses the reader's expected vision, and compares the reader's directional expectations, distributed control system structure, and designed new distribution The overall structure of the computer interlock system. Including the design of various components and system networks in the system, implementing control functions, operation management concentration, structural redundancy, distributed intelligence, dispersion communication, distributed load.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power Adaptive Path Changing Glitch Free Radix-4, Radix-8 Multipliers
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The emerging growth of digital systems depends on the errorless implementation of signal processing circuits. These circuits are implemented in VLSI platforms that provide reconfigurable clocking circuits. The clock signals are required to be stable and glitch free. In most of the digital circuit developments, multiplier plays a major role. The design implemented with less number of multipliers is highly demanded. These multiplier circuits are highly sensitive to glitches that occur due to fluctuations in power and floating elements. The proposed approach uses the RADIX-4 and RADIX-8 models with a glitch optimization circuit to construct a low power adjustable path selective Booth Multiplier architecture. The system utilized low power techniques like clock gating and sequenced latching process. The design is simulated using Modelsim tool and validated with test and evaluation of multiplier circuit with equivalent test bench. In comparison to the circuit with glitches, this model achieves low power elements after removal of glitch.

articleTitle: Human Resource Management Using Machine Learning-Based Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Human resource management (HRM) is more like a strategic alignment with the purpose. AI (Artificial Intelligence) based techniques are becoming increasingly significant in HRM operations. The firms are concentrating on more realistic solutions. ML (Machine learning) algorithms are currently making advances in a range of human resource management operations. This report gives an overview of critical HRM operational functions where AI-based solutions in particular ML techniques may be applied to improve accuracy of HRM operational processes. This paper addresses unique possible and probable opportunity of AI techniques, and focuses on features noted as (i) engaging employees, (ii) corporate culture administration, (iii) and the evaluation. The employment of ML techniques decision tree as well as logistic regression to enhance the possibility of solutions being more substantial as well as capable of offering the ideal evaluation process. If solutions are created along these lines, they can be advantageous to firms in terms of managing strategic HRM operational practices.

articleTitle: Crop Water Stress Identification and Estimation: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Water stress in plants is due to water deficiency probably caused by soil salinity and drought. Water stress in crops leads to loss in agricultural production that results in food shortage. Crop water stress index (CWSI) changes with respect to temperature, humidity, soil moisture, vapour pressure deficit(VPD), wind speed etc., Various environmental factors also need to be considered for crop water stress identification. Our paper reviews, on various effects, responses of water stress and methods used for Crop Water Stress Index identification for sustainable agriculture.

articleTitle: Analyze the Main Agent Modeling and Network Analysis of Community Grid Governance Legalization based on the Community Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The article analyzes the significance of the rule of law to the promotion of community governance, and analyzes the problems in the process of promoting the rule of law in the community, including the lack of scientific top-level design and the lack of standardized management of rules and regulations. Learning from the theory of multiple co-governance can better solve this reality The problem is to realize the legal transformation of the community grid governance system by optimizing the overall structure of multiple governance bodies. It focuses on the analysis of the interrelationship of the two and the explanatory power of collaborative governance to the innovation of grassroots social management. At the same time, the four theoretical foundations studied in this paper are analyzed, namely, system theory and synergy theory, governance theory, topic-agent theory, grid governance and seamless government theory.

articleTitle: Improving the Performance of Leukemia Detection using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Leukemia diagnosis is performed by blood tests and bone marrow diagnostic assay. In the health sector, blood cells counting plays a vital role. The technique used in hospital laboratories involves the manual numeration of blood cells victimization using a device referred to as Haemocytometer. Using this method can be monotonous, sometimes produces inaccurate results and also is a time consuming process. So as to beat the complications, this analysis presents an absolute automatic systemised system to associate with nursing platelets cells within the blood samples and to classify various forms of Leukaemia. Many issues and lost options in the existing cell classifiers are identified by implementing an effusively automatic technique employing a multi-class classifier. This approach identifies varied colour feature statistics with geographical measures in machine learning centred on supervised learning. This model has been trained and evaluated with few machine learning techniques, and offers an accuracy of 92%.

articleTitle: Detection of Facemask and Temperature Monitoring with Email Notification using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Various businesses are confronted with the challenge of selecting the best method to protect their staff and customers from the disruptions to their daily routines. The growth in corona trend has coincided with the opening of various stores, workplaces, and organizations. Facemasks are becoming increasingly required in these situations. for everyone. As a result of Covid-19, the demand for face mask identification technology and temperature recognition is increasing. Because of the COVID-19 pandemic, detecting someone who does not use a mask is challenging. The proposed concept might be deployed at a variety of locations, including school gates, restaurants, bank doors, and airports. The individual's body temperature and face mask must be confirmed before passing the gate. Individuals' faces are recognized by Open CV, which divides them into two groups: those who wear masks and those who do not.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Detection using Chest X-Rays with Image based Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The COVID-19 has become a global pandemic, which has already affected the health care and lifestyle of literally every person on earth. It has affected all over the world. The global healthcare system is being overwhelmed by the exponential increase in COVID-19 patients. One of the critical factors driving the rapid spread of the COVID-19 pandemic is the lengthy clinical testing time. In order speed up the process the identification process can be done using chest X-Ray. In this project, a computer vision-based deep learning model for detecting Covid-19 is proposed. A dataset scraped from the internet was used to train the model. NumPy, OpenCV, Matplotlib, and TensorFlow are among the Python 3 packages that are used to create the computer vision model. This method is created by training and testing the model to identify failures and establish recovery strategies. As a result, early diagnosis of Covid-19 using computer vision-based approaches is employed to lower the mortality rate. The work suggests using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to detect Covid-19. The model is fed data from chest X-ray images. The neural network is trained using a dataset of classified X-Ray images and classified between normal image and covid-19 image. It approaches the problem as a binary classification problem, that is, either Covid-19 or not. The goal is to achieve high accuracy and detect Covid-19 using the defined training model.

articleTitle: NLP Based Fake News Detection Using Hybrid Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Fake news is incorrect information. With the advent of false news on social media and other platforms, it is more important than ever to know the difference. Fake news contributes to riots, mayhem, mob violence, and other social and economic turmoil. Fake news can be created to purposely mislead or deceive readers, promote a biased point of view, a cause or goal, or just for fun. Fake news can be shared on social media, printed in publications due to political pressure, etc. Misinformation may cause public discontent, riots, and even distrust amongst individuals or nations. It also has the ability to tap into broad public sentiment in novel ways. The emergence of fake news has radically transformed news and media coverage. In recent years, people's news consuming patterns have altered. The internet has become the major source of information. However, most online content is untrustworthy and may even be deceptive. Humans can't identify certain fake news from real news. Fake news is created to mislead or deceive readers, support a biased point of view, a cause or goal, or just for fun. Fake news can be spread via unauthenticated user IDs, social media, and newspaper publishing. The proposed project will use hybrid machine learning model to detect bogus news in order to recognize the fake news easier.

articleTitle: Power Quality Enhancement in the Integration of Distributed Generation using Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Electrical energy is vital to the sustainability and quality of life on earth. Photovoltaic (PV) and wind energy are considered as the most efficient renewable energy technologies. Greenhouse gas emissions can be reduced with the proper usage of solar energy. In this research, a hybrid distributed generation of solar and wind energy is presented using Matlab software. Wind and solar power are two examples of renewable energy which have experienced a recent increase in synthesis due to environmental, social, and technical advantages over fossil fuel-based power generation. The most promising and well-established renewable energy technologies are solar and wind energy. This paper uses MATLAB software to analyze load flow analysis, short circuit analysis, and also the real and reactive power compensation. It presents a particle swarm optimization technique for performing harmonic suppression in distribution system along with nonlinear load. Transmission loss, fuel costs, and transmission line stability are reduced by using particle swarm optimization. In the MATLAB software, the models and simulations for a practical distributed grid is used for the construction and for validating the proposed system's design validity. To make the simulation models more realistic, real load and hybrid energy data is used. The outcome of the proposed analysis is used to display the output as a waveform and this has been discussed throughout this paper.

articleTitle: Experimental Validation of No-Touch Switch for Automation System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A button is the most prevalent interface for interacting with the digital world in this era of covid-19. Social separation is a major factor in the current Covid- 19 issue. To avoid contracting covid-19, it is critical not to contact the surface of buttons, keys, or switches that have been frequently used by others. To address this, switching technology must be innovated so that a hand-operated switch can be replaced with a contactless switch. With the evolution of technology, switches must be updated to keep up with the times. Traditional switches are rapidly being replaced with a centralised control system in modern homes. Our project's main goal is to create a no touch switch with a sensor that can sense hand gesture and transform the information into commands for operating lamps, fans as well as other household appliances. Furthermore, for managing the operation of various home appliances, this contactless switches uses an Arduino UNO as the main control device.

articleTitle: A Multifunctional Wireless EV Charger with New V2V Charging Assistance
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Our Project consists of Grid to Vehicle and Vehicle to Vehicle charging methods where the power is transferred wirelessly using the induction method. The primary coil’s connection is to both G to V and V to V of the transmitter side. The secondary coil is connected to the receiver side of the Electric Vehicle. A series of light-emitting diodes are attached to the car model for denoting the power transfer. The power is transmitted wirelessly in the gap between the two coils making the LEDs glow and the car model move.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection of Fetal QRS Complex using Time-Frequency Image Based Features and Deep Learning Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Automatic identification of fetal QRS complex plays a vital role in monitoring the fetal heart’s well-being. Noninvasive fetal electrocardiograms seem to be a promising approach for detecting fetal heart rates. The underlying challenge in processing abdominal ECG is eliminating maternal components and other noises to estimate an accurate fetal heart rate. A novel technique using time frequency image representation of abdominal ECG which can directly identify the fetal QRS complex is proposed in the paper. The TFI representation of abdominal signals benefits in presence of rich feature set and enhances the identification of fetal QRS. Abdominal ECG is represented as time-frequency images using Stockwell transform and input to the ResNet architecture. The performance of the proposed approach is evaluated using the 2013 challenge database. The proposed algorithm achieved an accuracy of 88.34, precision of 92.89, recall of 83.33, and F1 score of 87.85. The area under the ROC curve for the approach is 0.89. The obtained results proof that ST features are well suitable for detecting FQRS complex from the abdominal signals.

articleTitle: Handwritten Signature Verification Technology Using Deep Learning – A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Biometrics is currently widely utilized for the identification and verification of persons and their signatures all around the world. An individual's handwritten signature is a unique identifying work of human that is used and acknowledged primarily in banking and other financial and legal operations. However, handwritten signatures are becoming increasingly prized owing to their historical significance as a target of deception. The Sign Verification System (SVS) attempts to establish if a sign is genuine (created by the stated individual) or forged (produced by an impostor). Using images of scanned signatures and other documents without dynamic information about the signing process has proven difficult, especially in offline (static) situations. The use of Deep Learning algorithms to learn feature signature picture representations has been well-documented in the literature over the last five to ten years. Here, we examine how the subject has been studied throughout the last few decades, as well as the most recent developments and future study plans.

articleTitle: Analysis of Parallel Prefix Adders with Low Power and Higher Speed
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The addition of binary digits is regarded as one of the most essential operations in computer mathematics. To enhance the adder's efficiency, it must be both time and power efficient. Parallel prefix adders are more efficient than conventional adders. Kogge-stone, Brent-kung, Ladner, and Fischer are just a few of the adders that appear in this piece of art. Constructing an effective adder using the Brent Kung, Kogge-stone, and Ladner Fischer algorithms requires the use of parallel prefix architecture. A comparison of the power consumption, delay, and transistor count of prefix adders is done in this research.

articleTitle: Night Surveillance Robot for Women Safety
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Recently, women's safety is a critical concern in different countries across the globe. As a result, a safety monitoring robot controlled by a Raspberry Pi is supported in this research. To secure the surroundings, the device utilizes an internet based digicam, an infrared sensor, and a sound sensor installed on the robot platform. The robot vehicle follows a predetermined path with the assistance of IoT network. The IR sensor is utilized in this system to locate the obstructions in the path of the robot. The digicam will continually record the surrounding environment. When a sound is detected by the sound sensor, the digital camera (digicam) starts taking pictures and sends alert messages.

articleTitle: A Review on Developing Smart Mask for Individual Health Status Monitoring and Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The novel corona virus originated from animals and transmitted to human beings and spread across the world and so far 4,48,40,668 people got affected due to COVID 19. About 59, 94,519 people lost their life by the infections and respiratory problems. Different types of vaccine had been invented by many countries for the controlling and spread of the novel corona virus. The World Health Organization (WHO) had announced washing hands, wearing face mask and maintaining social distance will avoid the spread of the virus. Implementation of continuous lock down and making the people idle will lead to the cause of poverty and empowerment. The Government has taken several relief measures for bringing back all people to their normal life. The new normal life has changed the life style of every one by wearing mask as mandatory in shopping malls, theatres and all the public places. In this paper, a review is made on various literatures on the existing models to understand the challenges in embedding a sensor in face mask and sensing the health parameter of the infected persons, alerting the information of the infected persons in the crowded places, and tracking, monitoring the heart beat, pulse and movements of the infected persons. The existing challenges are overcome by proposing a new smart mask to monitor and predict the health status of the infected persons.

articleTitle: Forecasting Crop Using Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The majority of India’s population depends on agriculture as its main economic foundation and means of livelihood. Various techniques have been developed to study agricultural production prediction. Machine learning is a key component of such strategies. Machine learning is a crucial decision-support tool for predicting agricultural yields, enabling choices about which crops to cultivate and what to do while they are in the growth period. This study applied a variety of ML algorithms used in the assessment of agricultural yields. Probability of manufacturing should continually be anticipated to the close to perfection with the aid of using time collection evaluation. The distinguished type of strategies that has been employed in this paper and predicted the crop yield throughout the time period are Logistic Regression (LR), Naive Bayes (NB), and Decision Tree (DT).K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN). A greater accuracy rate of 93.17 is provided by the Logistic Regression model, which outperforms than the other three.

articleTitle: Application of Software Engineering Ideas in the Development of Management Information System: From the Perspective of Data Compression
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This article mainly expounds the connotation of management information system development from the perspective of data compression, analyzes the problems existing in the development and application of software engineering ideas in management information systems, and conducts certain research on the solutions to the problems, object-oriented, project management and Concepts such as components, through their application in management information system software development, software engineering ideas should be applied to system development in the management information system construction phase, to improve the defects in the management information system development, and form a scientific and reasonable development system.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Auxiliary Software in Sino-Russian Cross-Cultural Communication based on Russian Image Character Structure Extraction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper emphatically expounds the importance of encoding and decoding of Russian-language image character structure extraction algorithm in cross-cultural communication, and takes Russian-Chinese language as an example to list the similarities and differences conveyed by non-linguistic information in Russian-Chinese communication. sex. This paper starts with the goal of Russian teaching in colleges, firstly obtains the required dot matrix graphics of Russian letters, and establishes a Russian font set to meet the needs of data display and framing during interface design; The sequence relationship of alphabetic place. Put forward the countermeasures of Russian cultural knowledge teaching in the context of Sino-Russian cross-cultural communication, in order to provide a certain reference value for university Russian teaching.

articleTitle: Automized Gesture Controlled Switch
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The proposed system principally intimates the updated technology of contact-less switch with varied strategies together with gestures. Here gesture sensing element plays an important role in providing non-contact of interaction with individuals and therefore the projected system. The matter that has been known that the switches were used throughout the pandemic by the individuals for ON and OFF of electronic devices in public places. The impact may result in contract of Corona viruses. Gesture recognition is technology that uses sensors to scan and interrupt hand movements as a command. To avoid this type of scenario here comes contactless switch. The designed switch provides a secure use for the individuals in public places like malls, railway stations etc., The updated switch includes a sensing element which will notice hand movements and translate them into commands for dominant lights, fans, and varied alternative home appliances. The projected system offers development of recent technology.

articleTitle: Research on Key Strategies of using Multi-level and Multi-source Big Data to Conduct Smart Poverty Alleviation Audit
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the theoretical results of domestic and foreign big data audits based on multi-level and multi-source big data. From the overall analysis based on big data visualization technology, it finds suspicious data related to poverty alleviation and analyzes specific violations in the use of poverty alleviation funds based on big data technology. Starting from two aspects of the problem, it studied how to apply big data technology to carry out poverty alleviation audits, and explored applications in some poverty alleviation audit projects. It studied and proposed the use of big data technology to carry out relocation audits for poverty alleviation, dilapidated building renovation audits, and photovoltaic poverty alleviation. Auditing, "all-in-one card" benefit farmers subsidy audit methods, summarized the changes brought about by the use of big data technology to audit work and the current general technical bottlenecks in the construction of big data audits.

articleTitle: Modal Analysis System of Emotion First in Vocal Art Under the Background of Sound Wave Recognition and Matching
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the back-end pattern matching algorithm, and introduces the fuzzy-mean clustering algorithm in the model training process, which makes the recognition effect significantly improved. This algorithm has high robustness in clustering. It is introduced into the training algorithm to replace the commonly used hard clustering algorithm to find the initial point of the model. The importance of emotional expression in vocal performance art is analyzed, and then it is discussed. The measures to improve the emotional expression level of vocal performance art hope to bring help to the majority of colleagues to improve their artistic level. Correspondingly starts n sub-threads for concurrent computing. When the improved feature coefficients are applied to the Android platform, the equivalence rate is reduced by 7.24%, the recognition rate is increased by 6.8%, and the robustness in noisy environments has also been significantly improved. After adding 3 sub-threads, the computation time of feature extraction is shortened by about 35%.

articleTitle: Web based Application Platform to Give and Seek Support during Life Challenging Moments
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this modern era, there are millions of people who voluntarily come forward to support others. Thankfully, this digital era has made that possible. With the boom of social media, giving and seeking financial support during life-challenging moments has become quite easy. Despite the hype, some people are misusing the services. This results in increasing number of cyber thefts and fraudulent activities. Many helping hands have been reduced due to many unauthenticated WhatsApp & social media message forwards. Sometimes, this also leads to lack of support for the people who genuinely need help. This is an easy-to-use online tool to give and seek support during life-challenging moments. It is an interactive web application between the recipient who seeks support and the helper who gives support. The recipient can post the requirements and details will be posted only after thorough verification. The helper can give support and if he/she finds that particular post/story needs immediate attention, they can vote for it for a better reach. The recipient will be able to update the status of the story so that fellow users can keep track of this. There are a lot of features like that on this application that is user-friendly. We’ve used MEAN stack technology for developing this application.

articleTitle: Intelligent English Online Classroom Real-Time Feedback System based on Remote Computer Monitoring Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Intelligent English online classroom real-time feedback system based on the remote computer monitoring algorithms is studied in the paper. The computer monitoring system can use the HTTP protocol in remote communication technology to realize the purpose of real-time monitoring in different regions. The staff only need to use the central console computer and web server to carry out relevant work operations on the related monitoring systems in other regions, and can not only query the pictures monitored by each camera. With this core technology, this paper then consider the novel remote computer monitoring algorithm to implement the English online classroom real-time feedback system. The performance of the system is well validated through the testing.

articleTitle: Optimization and Comparative Testing of Information Security Algorithms in the Process of Informatization Construction of Tourism Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the frequent internal and external information security problems in the process of informatization construction of tourism enterprises, and provides countermeasures in technology and management for the healthy development of informatization construction of tourism enterprises. The computer simulation shows that, the transformed orthogonal matrix is similar to the original matrix in reducing the peak-to-average power ratio of the OFDM signal, and can be used in information security algorithms. Combined with support vector machine algorithm, the deployment guarantee model is constructed. The experimental comparison results show that the accuracy of the model test set after using the random forest algorithm for feature optimization increases by about 8%.

articleTitle: Spatial Spectral based 3D Feature Map for EEG Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: One of the most commonly used non-invasive techniques for emotion recognition is the electroencephalogram (EEG). EEG can be used to record electrical activity in the brain and cannot be voluntarily fabricated. The electroencephalogram (EEG) is a physiological indicator that shows how electrical activities of brain cells cluster across the human cerebral cortex. Research works that demonstrate how the most complete characteristics of EEG, such as Power Spectral Density (PSD) can be used to classify basic emotions. This paper proposes an efficient method for predicting human emotions using spatial-spectral aspects of EEG and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). To create a 3D map, spectral features such as PSD and Differential Entropy (DE) are extracted. The 3D brain map is used as an input to a CNN model for classifying emotions into valence and arousal by producing accuracy of 89.38% and 90.12% respectively.

articleTitle: On Minimizing TCP Traffic Congestion Control in Vehicular Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Vehicular communication is an emerging field and will experience a substantial rise in wireless exchange of information. Heavy usage of internet traffic introduces a higher likelihood of network congestion. Several internet congestion control algorithms are used to regulate transmission rates that continuously monitor packet losses and timeouts to identify congestion in the network. In the vehicular environment, packet loss eventuality happens due to mobility and channel losses. In this paper, a new algorithm called the Congestion Aware Rate Tuning (CART) is proposed to identify network congestion based on the estimation of Bottleneck Limit Threshold (BLT) parameter. This algorithm won’t respond to packet loss and timeout conditions. The parameters average throughput, average goodput and mean delay are taken as metrics to analyse the performance of this algorithm. Simulation results of the comparison between the existing Transmission Control Protocol Westwood algorithm and CART algorithm in NS-3 shows a considerable increment in throughput, goodput, and mean delay in vehicular conditions.

articleTitle: An Efficient Dual Stage Compressor for High Speed VLSI Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Approximation can be used to reduce the overhead on compute units of a processor, allowing it to achieve high performance and execution efficiency. The speed of operation, which is inversely proportional to the system's latency, necessitates massive parallel processes that consume a lot of hardware and energy. Relaxing the accuracy and dependability of the system might result in energy and area efficient solutions. Approximate computing has emerged as a viable method for maintaining the balance between latency, area, and power. A typical operation in approximation computing systems for high speed and low power computing is approximate application. These applications provide tremendous performance at the expense of precision. Furthermore, such methods minimise system architectural complexity, latency, and power consumption. An approximate 4:2 compressor can be used to create power-efficient circuits for approximation multiplication. This paper proposes a novel design that uses a modification of a previous approximate 4:2 compressor design and adds an error recovery module, delay and power with comparable accuracy when compared with the existing architecture. Even with the extra error recovery module, the suggested design is more accurate, uses less hardware, and consumes less power than the previously proposed approximation multiplier design based on 4:2 compressor. These designs are made with 130nm CMOS technology, and their efficiency has been thoroughly tested and predicted on scales of power, delay and Power Delay Product (PDP). An unique 4:2 compressor architecture with excellent speed, area efficiency, and low power is suggested. The proposed compressors are utilized to implement in multipliers. The study will also be expanded to include high-speed applications.

articleTitle: Energy Harvesting For IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Irrefutably, most of the IoT devices are energized through batteries. Owing to the restricted operating life of batteries, this is the need of hour to have IoT device which can get the power from device itself or there should be some alternative energy source which can continuously feed power to the IoT devices. As an alternative source, various energy harvesters are being used to power up the ample of IoT devices. Energy harvesters utilize some renewable resource of energy to produce the desired amount of DC output voltage to further feed to IoT devices. Therefore, the significance of energy harvesters for IoT applications is presented in this article. Starting with the demand of energy harvesters and their design, this article also presents the comparison and requirements of various energy harvesting systems for applications in IoT devices.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Aspects Level Drug Reviews using Back Propagation Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Several aspects, such as drug interactions and adverse effects, must be taken into account before prescribing a drug. The fact that some pharmacological qualities, such as side effects, are dependent on patient variables such as age and gender, complicates the procedure even further. Our goal is to create a platform that will aid doctors in prescription medications. This paper devises a method for searching for medications that meet a set of criteria based on drug attributes. Both healthcare professionals who prescribe and dispense pharmaceuticals, as well as drug users, should take several precautions when using pharmaceutical drugs. Prescription drug interactions, interactions with the patient’s existing medicine, potential adverse effects, and contraindications must all be considered. Furthermore, patient characteristics such as age, gender, habits, and genetic profiles influence pharmacological attributes such as side effects and efficacy. The objective is to develop a system that will assist medical professionals and drug users in choosing and locating appropriate drugs. Users can select side effects and the approach answers to their needs. Data about drugs comes from a variety of places. Medicine data, on the other hand, is typically noisy and incomplete because it is either manually developed or mechanically retrieved from text resources like drug labels. Data science technology known as a supervised Machine learning algorithm can be used to analyze medications based on various aspects with better accuracy to deal with incomplete and noisy data.

articleTitle: Multidimensional Quantitative Measurement Analysis of Big Data Application Ability based on Mathematical Modeling Path
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Based on the multi-dimensional quantitative measurement of the application ability of big data modeling ideas based on the mathematical modeling path, this paper briefly explains the importance of the fusion of the two, and deeply analyzes the difficulties faced by the current fusion, and proposes a feasible fusion path. In order to provide suggestions and references for higher mathematics educators. Seven quantitative measures of IPC number, patent grant rate, H index, G index, patent effectiveness, and patent implementation rate. Conduct empirical research on the technological innovation capabilities of Chinese universities. Through SPSS software analysis, it is verified that there is a strong system among the indicators. Sexuality and relevance can objectively quantify the technological innovation capabilities of colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Application of Hierarchical Optimal Random Walk Algorithm in Data Specification of College Sports Training Intelligent Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper studies the application of hierarchical optimal random walk algorithm in data specification of college sports training intelligent platform. The algorithm proposed here is aimed at the representation of a neighbor node. Since the user may have multiple neighbor nodes, the final core vector representation of the user is the fusion of all its neighbor nodes. The representative sample network of the original social network can be obtained by sampling technology, so as to achieve the purpose of reducing the scale of network data. Hence, with these supporting technologies, the designed model is considered with the hierarchical optimal random walk algorithm. The experimental results have presented the effectiveness.

articleTitle: IoT Enabled Smart Parking using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A developed urban city is always accustomed to lots of cars on its roads but is alternatively not equipped with the required parking space. The increased scalability of the number of vehicles due to increase in population makes allotment of parking space challenging. The other difficulties faced are congestion created due to increased vehicles, wastage of space and time, traffic issues, difficulty in cruising etc. Every time the person driving a vehicle enters the parking lot, they attempt to find an empty space for the vehicle to be parked which leads to loss of time and energy, especially during peak hours. Smart Parking Assistant provides an optimized solution to overcome the above problems. It also provides a sophisticated parking assistance in economical cars. It mainly deals to avoid crash and confusion during car parking in unorganized and unknown parking areas.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Real-Time Tracking Systems using Bluetooth Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A real-time tracking system refers to a tracking device that send information to the end-user at a consistently high frequency. It offers clients with the following updates at regular intervals. GPS based tracking devices will send information about their situations by taking the signs. The proposed framework can be utilized for ensuring the security of humans. Today, most of the android phones are equipped with Global Positioning System (GPS). They can be productively used for security and insurance purposes. The proposed application is attractively designed to make it suitable for both younger and elderly population. A global positioning framework is used here to track and monitor children. The primary objective of the proposed research work is to create a novel framework, will allow parents to monitor their children even in their absence. In any case, with the global positioning framework, the parent can track and screen their child in a simple application. The real-time monitoring system is a multi-purpose security framework, which can be utilized in any health related Android applications. A wearable smart band can be worn on a child's wrist for monitoring purpose. This also contributes to a reduction in crime rates. This paper focuses on developing a wearable band, which assist in child monitoring. With the help of an online Android application, parents can easily monitor the children at home. The proposed prototype model is extremely beneficial for senior citizens and people suffering from memory disorders. Moreover, this device serves as a communication link between the child wearing and his or her parents.

Author Keywords: global positioning framework and Global System Mobile Communication

articleTitle: Android Implementation of Teaching Management Refinement System based on Cyclic Data Interpolation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The spatial data interpolation algorithm is used to perform grid interpolation on the scattered raw data, and then the regular grid data is volume rendered by the light projection volume rendering algorithm. This paper proposes a discontinuous B-spline interpolation based on the Android platform. The algorithm interpolates the image with a traditional 3rd degree non-uniform B-spline in the smooth region. This paper uses Google's Android platform. The system designed in this paper includes three main functional modules: online course selection module, mobile grade module, and mobile Internet teaching evaluation module. This paper elaborates the design and implementation of the three main modules in detail.

articleTitle: Quantitative Modeling of the Correlation Between Cognitive Motivation and Behavioral Incentives of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises based on Intelligent Punch-In Information System and Matlab Implement
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: At present, there are problems in the core employee incentive mechanism of my country's small and medium-sized enterprises, such as imperfect employee performance appraisal system, unreasonable salary mechanism of enterprises, lag in spiritual incentives, lack of emphasis on employee training and development, and insufficient influence on corporate culture. If SMEs want to retain talents, they should establish an effective incentive mechanism and seriously solve the above problems. This paper designs and implements an enterprise intelligent attendance management system based on the characteristics of the enterprise itself. Power enterprise intelligent attendance management system can greatly improve the company's work efficiency and management capabilities. In this paper, the quantitative modeling based on Matlab and the realization algorithm of Matlab are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Design of Energy Efficient Magnitude Comparator Architecture using 8T XOR Gate
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper proposes a CMOS comparator circuitry with a three-stage topology for a high-speed Analog-to-Digital Converter (ADC). The speed of ADC is limited by the used comparator. Hence, the optimization of the comparator is crucial for a fast ADC. In computationally intensive designs, the use of comparators is inevitable. The optimization of comparator design while maximizing speed, minimizing power dissipation, and minimizing area is needed. Though the dynamic logic-based comparators are successful in minimizing power consumption, they pose challenges such as low-speed and poor-noise margin. In this paper, a low power and area efficient magnitude comparator is designed by utilizing an 8T xor gate. In the proposed xor gate power gating is applied so that the power consumption can be optimized. This proposed low power xor –xnor module is the fundamental circuit in the comparator circuit. Hence, the power consumption of digital comparator is also reduced. The recommended comparator is composed of 2 modules namely, CEM (Comparison Evaluation Module) and the FM (Final Evaluation Module). All the designs are simulated in Tanner EDA tool using 180nm technology.

Author Keywords: dynamic power consumption and Analog to Digital converters

articleTitle: Implementation and Multi-Platform Test Algorithm for Customer Relationship Management Platform Under Multi-Structure Distributed Data Background
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper reviews customer relationship management, mass customization and CRM for mass customization, establishes a "CRM research architecture", and points out the limitations of CRM research for mass customization. The demand analysis of CRM for mass customization is carried out. By effectively utilizing idle clients on the Internet, it can realize the scheduling and distribution of test tasks on the Internet, the automatic completion of test tasks, and the collection and analysis of test results. the core modules of the platform. Using Microsoft Visual Studio .NET 2010 as the development platform, using C# language for application development, and applying ADO.NET technology to achieve efficient database communication on the Internet.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Geospatial Serverless Computing for Geospatial Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Nowadays, real-world applications are primarily concerned with collecting the physical characteristics that correspond to various geographical phenomena, and information plays a critical role in the analysis and forecast of various occurrences that occur. Real-time analysis is used in a variety of application domains, including traffic flow monitoring, healthcare monitoring, and so on. This research study has considered the existing geospatial serverless computing framework and proposed an analytical model to enable the geospatial serverless platform to compute and operate at different workloads and the tradeoff between the cost and performance are then determined by the users’ preferences. Here, the accuracy of the model is validated in Amazon Web Service (AWS) Lambda environment and the model calculations are shown based on the performance metrics by including average response time, probability of cold start as well as the average amount of functional instances in the steady state by using the queuing theory. Here, the performance modelling is carried out in the geospatial serverless environment for different workloads, which results in delivering better performance at a minimal cost.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Implementation Path of Ideological Guiding in Colleges from the Perspective of Computer Internet and Massive Information Broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This article combines the computer Internet and the background of massive information dissemination and the current status of colleges and universities using new media to carry out ideological and political education for college students. Under the clear and accurate grasp of the basic theory of the path of college students’ ideological and political education from the perspective of information dissemination, it is aimed at current colleges and universities. New media develops the path dependence that appears in the ideological and political education of college students, grasps the characteristics of the form, law, and influence of student behavior in the second classroom under the background of the new era, and explores the path and method of behavior research for guiding and implementing ideological and political education.

articleTitle: Enhancing Energy Efficiency of Intensive Computing Applications using Approximate Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Approximate computing is an emerging idea of computation, which is mostly used in edge computing to design more efficient (faster, low power) computing platforms. This work focuses on and demonstrates multiple algorithmic level approximate computing techniques (ACTs), and their outcomes are observed and are further combined to compound their benefits in specific applications. In addition to the benefits, the assessed approximate computing techniques are also checked for guaranteeing the metrics that are required in intensive applications. The suitable approximate computing techniques that meet the requirements are applied in the front camera vehicle detection application and the performance and the accuracy loss results are presented for the chosen application.

articleTitle: Safe and Secure Systems in the Residence and Lender using Voice Recognition and GSM
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The project's main aim is to propose the formulation and construction of a SECURED AUTOMATION in a bank and at home using GS M and voice recognition. All of these techniques have evolved into a single automation system that provides a complete, low-cost, powerful, real-time remote-control system. This system is linked to the PIC16F877A microcontroller's inbuilt ADC, and its output is used to control as well as activate the load. GS M allows for trans mission and reception, while S MS allows for monitoring of the load's activation and control status, providing security for the system. If the user forget to turn OFF any appliances, the user can use their mobile phones to send an S MS to a GS M appended to the proposed system, which will then turn OFF the load. A remote has indeed been provided for each employee for security purposes and should be pressed whenever an unauthorized person enters the bank, because an unconscious gas has been s prayed, the bank's door is locked, an emergency alarm sounds, and an S MS is sent to the police and the bank's headquarters. As a result, the receiving process occurs for security in both the home and the bank.

articleTitle: Microcontroller based Mosquito Prevention and Elimination on Water Body by Integrated Subsystems
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Mosquitoes are the primary host for a variety of animal borne diseases that spread by the bite of an infected mosquito. Every year, more people die as a result of mosquito bites than as a result of war’s consequences. Mosquitoes transmit diseases to humans and infect humans with such ailments. There are chemical methods which can lower the mosquito populations in our neighborhoods by burying trash, filling puddles, stocking ponds with fish, and eliminating locations where water sits on the ground to kill mosquito’s as it may harm the environment. This research study proposes an integrated system which consists of primary and secondary subsystems to prevent and eliminate mosquito populations on water body. The primary system is used to create the ripples across the pond so that larvae of the mosquito’s do not survive. The secondary subsystem is used for trapping of adult mosquitoes with the help of UV light and a DC fan. The proposed solution is able to eliminate mosquitoes through both passive and active methodologies. The combination of these two subsystems is able to kill the mosquitoes both in adult and larvae stage. The proposed system can ensure the maximum level of success for the eradication of mosquitoes as the solution target them at two critical stages of their life cycle.

articleTitle: Sign and Machine Language Recognition for Physically Impaired Individuals
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Sign language is a type of communication used by people who are deaf or hard of hearing. Disabled People use sign language gestures as a non-verbal communication tool to express their feelings and thoughts to other people. It's tough to converse with those who are deaf or hard of hearing.
