Deaf and mute persons communicate via hand gesture sign language, which makes it difficult for non-deaf and mute people to understand their language. As a result, technologies that recognise numerous signs and communicate the data to regular people are needed. However, because these ordinary people have a hard time understanding their expressions, experienced sign language experts are required for medical and legal appointments, as well as educational and training sessions. There has been an upsurge in demand for these services in recent years. Other types of services, such as video remote human interpreter using a high-speed Internet connection, have been established, providing an easy-to-use sign language interpreter service that may be utilised and benefited, but with significant limits. In order to address this issue, the artificial intelligence technology can be implemented to analyze user’s hand with finger detection. A novel system has been suggested to design the vision-based system in real time environments. Then the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm is used to classify the sign language and provide the label about recognized sign with voice alert.

articleTitle: Predicting Bankruptcy and Suggesting Improvements on Financial Attributes using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Many financial players, including business investors, market analysts, banking experts, politicians, and shareholders, have been paying attention to the subject of corporate bankruptcy in recent years. Predicting company failure is crucial not just for financial institution decision-making, but it also influences the country’s financial suffering to some extent, since poor financial institution decision-making can have devastating consequences on a national or even global scale. The proposed system uses the Random Forest Model on the Polish Bankruptcy dataset to predict whether a company will go bankrupt in the near future. The dataset contains 10000 records and 64 attributes and which help in classifying a company as bankrupt or not bankrupt with an accuracy of 97.35%. The system has also incorporated the linear regression model to determine what should be the value of a particular attribute so that the financials of the company remain stable and it won’t go bankrupt. This system will help prevent bad-debts that have an impact on the economy while also making sure that the company remains afloat by checking its status regularly.

articleTitle: Secured Health Data Sharing System using Cloud Technology and Blockchain with Machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper proposes a systematic approach for storing and managing personal health related dynamic data using the concept of blockchain supported with cloud storage to store huge amounts of records with high integrity and security. In addition, this paper gives out a data segregation and quality inspection module which works on the concept of Naive Bayes Classification algorithm. The main objective of the paper is to let people construct, manage and stake their records with high accuracy in security, using the methodologies of Data Protection. Firstly, the data is segregated into different sections based on four segregation methods under Naive Bayes classification for the data entered into the system by the user. Secondly, this paper crushes down the limitation of size by using blockchain along with cloud storage. The paper also stores the personal health data after encrypting it with the use of AES Encryption in the cloud based on the concept of blockchain. Thirdly, a data quality and segregation module are included in this paper to have a control over the quality of the data using a Machine Learning technique called Naive Bayes Classification. This paper also gives a systematic approach for scholars and data scientists to have data of high quality for research purposes.

articleTitle: Digital Economy Development, Technological Innovation and Export Technology Complexity from the Perspective of big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Digital economy development, technological innovation and export technology complexity from the perspective of big data is studied in the paper. The article first introduces the multi-dimensional redundant data mining under big data mining. By analyzing the internal relations of big data, a multi-dimensional data de-clustering algorithm analysis model suitable for big data processing is established and the algorithm is improved. And experimental analysis, it is found that the complexity of the algorithm during sampling is relatively low. In the expert scoring link of the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model, the level difference of the review experts is considered, so as to control the expert review behavior through method design and reduce the evaluation of scientific and technological achievements. The influence of man-made factors. The empirical analysis shows that the model is feasible and practical.

articleTitle: The Matlab Realization of the Fusion Information Framework of Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao by the Low-Altitude Sensor Network Construction of Civil Aviation Transportation Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The de velopment of civil aviation transportation has a very significant and continuous positive impact on regional economic growth, which reaches a maximum value of 0.105 in the first period, and then declines year by year. The goal and principle of Qinhuangdao Port's smart port construction are put forward, and the overall framework of Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao smart port is built according to the overall design idea, and then the logistics supply chain service cloud platform, intelligent terminal platform, and Matlab customer service platform are respectively established, and builds a more reasonable and practical module in the learning design section. In the module design of the existing teaching information model, some of the test resource files, such as the test resource file set.

articleTitle: Design of Interactive Guidance Platform and Data Fusion Analysis of English Courses in Mobile JavaScript Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Under the ubiquitous learning environment, design an English information sharing platform based on JavaScript technology. By giving the overall English information sharing platform structure, each hardware part is analyzed in detail, and RSS technology is used to improve the rate of English information push and integration, and improve English information Sharing speed, the method of integrating information technology and college English teaching in the Internet era, in order to provide feasible ideas for college English informatization teaching, and finally based on JS to study the design of the English course mutual assistance guidance platform and the data fusion model.

articleTitle: Air Damping Effects on Perforated RF MEMS Switches
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: RF MEMS Switch with a Fixed-Fixed membrane structure is designed for testing the dampening impact of squeezing films. A shunt-type MEMS switch is the other name for fixed beam switch. A RF MEMS switch squeeze film damping is examined in this study for fixed-fixed beam. On the beam membrane which touches the substrate when voltage is applied, air damping analysis is performed for a variety of membrane designs with different sizes of etch holes. It was determined that a membrane with a 60-micron-long slit was better at simulating the distribution of pressure and damping force on the membrane. The obtained pressure distribution on the squeezes film reduces the closing times of the RF-MEMS switches. Damping force is explored for a range of ambient pressure settings by examining the influence of hole diameter and square hole length. The damping force varies very little with hole radius and square hole length at low ambient pressures. In COMSOL Multiphysics, damping force and surface pressure are modeled and simulated.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Game Research on Webcast Governance Strategies based on Deep Analysis of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The rapid prosperity of webcasting has also caused many social problems. To strengthen the governance of the chaos of webcasting, an active exploration should be initiated on the strategic choices of stakeholders in the governance of webcasting. Based on the evolutionary game theory, a game model between the main stakeholders of webcasting, namely, the network supervision department, the webcasting platform and the webcasting users is constructed, and the behavior of the stakeholders is simulated through Matlab. The results show that the social punishment coefficient has a positive effect on the alliance members’ choice of sharing strategies, and the speculative return coefficient has a negative influence on the alliance members’ choice of sharing strategies. Increasing the degree of sharing activity is conducive to the transformation of alliance members from a passive sharing state to an active sharing state.

articleTitle: Compact Metamaterial Based Wideband Bandpass Filter With Substrate Integrated Waveguide Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Using the substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) and metamaterial approach, a novel compact wideband bandpass filter operating at C and X band is proposed here. Three CSRRs are etched on the surface of the SIW to achieve bandpass responses. Pass band frequency of the proposed filter ranges from 6GHz to 15GHz with a maximum insertion loss of 0.46 dB at 14.72GHz and a minimum of 0.17 dB throughout pass band range. The dimensions of the proposed bandpass filter are 15mmx13mmx1.6mm for an FR-4 substrate of ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>=4.3. To validate the design and study the performance characteristics of the filter CST software was used.

articleTitle: Prediction of Heart attack using Supervised Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Heart is the fundamental organ that siphons blood to the body and for appropriate working of body. Coronary illness is a lethal human infection expanding all around the world in both created and lacking nations and thusly, causes passing. Ordinarily, in this sickness, the heart neglects to supply an adequate measure of blood to different pieces of the body to achieve their ordinary functionalities. Many risk factors for coronary disease and the need for accurate, reliable, and acceptable approaches to manage the condition are connected together in this situation. Medical professionals may better predict coronary heart disease with the use of information mining and artificial intelligence (AI) tools developed by scientists. The suggested approach is to construct an AI model capable of classifying whether or not a certain person has coronary artery disease. Various calculations are pondered and the best model is utilized for anticipating the result.

articleTitle: Load Flow Algorithm for Variable Economical Power Dispatch of Electricity Generation including Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Traditional economic dispatching, which is based on a Constant current model, ignores the onset of decline, resulting in a power generation plan is unable to achieve its primary operational goal of decreasing transmission network loss. When both the electricity grid and the energy grid are optimized, and the load management of the consumer are incorporated into to the standard strength creation of economic dispatch prototype, the versatility supplies just on creation, matrix, and charge edges of energy systems have been utilized to inspire its use of large amounts of wind that are obtained directly. It is necessary to use the large M approach to convert the suggested interconnected power system load shedding ability to associate of model together into mixed integer model in order for it to be implemented. Here, to develop DRL system for determining the optimum value of used techniques for VPPs. Our proposed technique reduced computing cost while concurrently encompassing a large of distributed power generation. The second step comprises economic dispatch while accounting for network drop and protection variants, with two goals set for this stage. One is to reduce losses, and the other is to keep generator output as near as feasible to the original generating plan.

articleTitle: Advanced Industry Temperature Controlling and Energy Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Energy is no exception to the fact that humans generate a lot of waste. When coal is burned in a power plant, the majority of the chemical energy in the fuel is not transformed into useable electricity or work. About two-thirds of the energy generated by a traditional power plant is lost as waste heat that escapes from a cooling tower, so part of the problem is that industries use gas or steam to generate electricity, which is based on the combustion of fuel to produce heat energy. Because only one-third of the energy released by the fuel ends up in the wire leaving the power station. Thus, the waste heat can be cleaned up and converted into usable electricity, which makes power generation more efficient. This would be good for the environment because less fuel would be burnt and less CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> would be emitted. In such a case, TEG can be used. Thermoelectric Generators (TEGs) are devices that use the thermoelectric effect to capture energy from temperature differences and convert it to electricity. This technique has the potential to minimize fuel consumption, and it can also be used to reduce energy consumption in other energy-intensive industries.

articleTitle: A Hadoop Framework Realization of Online Physical Education Practice System based on Large-Scale Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A Hadoop framework realization of the physical education practice research based on large-scale data analysis is studied in the paper. Different types of data are obtained with the support of the device interfaces, including structured, semi-structured and unstructured types of data. At the same time, there may be errors, redundancy or useless big data. Hence, in the designed model, the Hadoop is combined. In order to realize the high-performance MapReduce cluster design based on GPU acceleration, a high-performance MapReduce state fusion and task scheduling model is established by using open source coding and program loading methods. With the implementation of the designed model, the framework realization of the physical education practice research has been studied. The overall performance is validated through testing.

articleTitle: Opinion Mining based Identifying Deceptive Reviews
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: People nowadays are using online reviews to purchase products online. These reviews affect the sales of the product and play a major role in the company’s profits. The gradual increase in the number of social networks is paving the way for the checking of truthfulness of various reviews that are conducted online. Also, some cyber criminals are used to target some of the products, organizations or even individuals. The tasks performed by such individuals are called as Opinion Spamming and the individuals are called as Opinion Spammers. This process of Opinion Spamming not only damages the money and reputation of the organizations. But also plays a crucial role in the politics. As technology is getting highly sophisticated, it is becoming very difficult to identify such Spamming activities. This paper concentrates on various detection techniques of Opinion Spamming and suggests some of the ways to prevent it.

articleTitle: Internet of Things (IoT) in Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) offers enormous potential to carry out tasks efficiently in the modern era of technology. IoT devices, as their name suggests, include sensors and other tools that are directly connected to the internet. Such a machine can be taught to perform a wide range of tasks in the fields of agriculture, science, and military, among many others. The proposed approach in this study addresses how the agriculture industry could benefit from the Internet of Things. An IoT can be used for a variety of purposes, including farm security, ensuring that agricultural products are produced, transported, and sold properly, and much more. The proposed model, which is covered in more detail below, discusses the use of drones, autonomous tractors, and defense systems that are essential for creating intelligent agricultural land. Through adequate AI monitoring and control, these gadgets can be made to operate well and serve a variety of purposes. After the labor in the fields is finished, a farmer may practically unwind thanks to the installation of adequate sensors in the aerial machine, ground machine, and defensive mechanism.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of DoS Attack Detection in KDD CUP99 using Machine Learning Classifier Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The Internet of Things models are vulnerable is still wreaking havoc on commercial and critical sectors. The heterogeneity of different devices in IoT and their broad expansion has resulted in the emergence of numerous threats for security and privacy, severely impeding the collection, analysis, and correlation of IoT-centric data. With the fast growth of threats and the diversity of attack, IoT systems face significant hurdles in detecting security flaws and attacks. With the increase in the number of IoT devices, the volume of traffic generated by IoT-based assaults has been steadily increasing. One of the most serious IoT risks is the IoT botnet attack, which tries to commit genuine, efficient, and successful cybercrimes. Botnets have emerged as a key concern in IoT landscape, owing to the significant damages these collections of compromised IoT devices cause. Botnets are probably the most common form of the Internet's harmful traffic. It's dangerous because a large number of infected hosts are working together to focus on a single target. An efficient model to detect attacks in IoT is required so as to take corrective actions at the faster pace. In this paper, Machine learning models including Gaussian Naive Bayes, SVM, Gradient Boosting, Logistic Regression, One vs Rest, Random Forest, Decision tree, KNN and SGD are implemented on KDD CUP99 dataset to detect Denial-of–services attack. Decision tree model is found to be efficient model to classify the attacks at quicker pace and higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Environmental Financial Scheduling based on Information Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Environmental finance is an innovative financial model for the financial industry to meet the needs of environmental protection, and it is a way for the financial industry to play an important role in the sustainable development of economy. Based on the basic theories of environmental economics and financial innovation, environmental finance emphasizes market-oriented macro financial market-oriented management and incentive to micro financial innovation. In order to cope with the sharp pressure of resources and environment, realize the sustainable growth of economic growth and environmental protection. Based on the information platform, this paper studies the modeling and Simulation of environmental finance scheduling, which lays the foundation for the big data analysis of environmental finance.

articleTitle: Construction of Data Intelligent Evaluation System for Children's Sense of Humor based on the Fusion of Facial Expression Recognition and Blink Frequency Recognition Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Based on the relationship analysis of the subjects' left forehead EEG signal fusion expression recognition and blink frequency recognition algorithms and Blink data, the optimal window width and classification algorithm were screened respectively, and a humor detection algorithm suitable for wearable devices was designed. , and then construct a data intelligent evaluation system of children's sense of humor through Bayesian network based on student information and contextual information of teaching activities. The sense of humor in the kindergarten is mainly for viewing; the sense of humor focuses on education; the safety guarantee pays attention to the feedback of space, and the evaluation form of sports space in kindergarten is obtained according to the system.

articleTitle: Review of Article: Benefits of Wearable Technology to Provide Efficient Nursing Care
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Wearable technology is a device that can wear on the body and allow for screening and monitoring of a person. This wearable technology has an impact on health care and it is the future of nurses. Nurses are the frontline caregiver to patients. Healthcare practitioners will be able to attend to even more patients with more efficiency, significantly reducing patient wait times for care and treatment after using wearable technology. This technology help nurses from a different perspective, this can help in monitoring vital signs, help in neurological disorders patients, diabetic patients, wound care, maternal and infant monitoring, heart patients and many more. These devices give benefits for personal use to nurses, for contact with other health workers and for self-care also. Wearables give benefits to nurses for providing efficient nursing care, the benefit for early recovery of patients, detecting the early sign of an emergency, reducing further complications and reducing the death rate.

articleTitle: No Parking Detection and Security System using Vehicle Number Plate Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The Automatic Number Plate Recognition System (ANPR) is one among the recent technological innovations in the domain of smart cities. Surveillance cameras are usually installed in different locations across highways and in metropolitan areas for monitoring and reporting purposes. Vehicle number plate detection and recognition in challenging conditions, such as low illumination, unstable weather, and unavoidable noise has increasingly become the focus of the research studies. The proposed work describes a novel system that uses metropolitan security surveillance system to enforce parking restrictions. The captured image is processed and the vehicles are identified by using the Region based Convolution Neural Network (R-CNN) algorithm, which is a well-known method for performing object detection in deep learning domain. It could also be used to enforce traffic laws. The development tool used in this system is Python. The proposed approach provides a feasible solution to the difficult challenges associated with the notion of long-term monitoring.

articleTitle: IoT Group Key Management using Incremental Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Sensors and the internet are used in the Internet of Things (IoT) to link physical and computer networks. Future IoT development will be heavily influenced by machine learning and cloud computing. Wi-Fi and ethernet are the most common methods of connecting IoT devices to the internet today. Because of the great range and low latency of the 5G cellular network, most gadgets will choose it in the future. This study discusses how to overcome the limitations of early key management systems and provides a key mechanism that is more effective in the Internet of Things context. Prior to this, the network had been deployed and was being operated by interactions using a mathematical structure known as the blom’s key pre- distribution approach. In the event that a new user needs to join the network, the system generates a random group and distributes the secret key. Extra time is required for both processing and communication, as is evident from the outset. To reduce the time it takes to maintain the key distribution within a group or network, this article outlines the use of machine learning principles. Subgroups based on features will likewise be created by this method In addition, the nodes are grouped into viewpoint subgroups, and the secret key is successfully sent among the nodes.

articleTitle: COVID 19: Identification of Masked Face using CNN Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Tackling with the Covid-19 pandemic has been a grueling task from the day one of its rise. To prevent the spread of the virus, one of the major steps taken by governments of the world is to mandate the use of face masks in public places. This has made face recognition process in today’s era quite a hideous process as masked faces are difficult to analyze because most of the key parts of the face get covered by the mask. Thus, it raises a matter of great concern when security and individual identification comes into play. Therefore, this paper proposes a reliable system to recognize the individual even when the face is covered with mask. The first step aims to convert all the images of the database to grayscale and then convert them into vectors. This reduces the contributing factor of the masked region in the prediction process. The vectors are then fed to a Convolutional Neural Network. A sequential model is defined to design multiple layers of the network and generate output. The proposed model showed maximum accuracy of 90% after tuning the key parameters of the model.

articleTitle: Automated Breast Cancer Classification based on Modified Deep learning Convolutional Neural Network following Dual Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: As soon as possible, breast cancer must be diagnosed and treated. Deep learning-based breast cancer classification and segmentation approaches are introduced in this research. A novel computer-aided detection method is described for the classification of normal and malignant mass tumors. This system employs two types of segmentation. The first approach relies on manually determining the ROI, whereas the second makes use of thresholds and a region-based strategy. An AlexNet DCNN framework is used to extract features and categories two kinds of data. Support vector machine classifiers are plugged into the final layer for better accuracy. A high accuracy rate is achieved through training on a vast amount of data. Despite this, due to patient capacity limitations, biomedical databases contain a relatively smaller sample. Thus, image enhancement may be used to increase the amount and quality of input data. Data augmentation may be done in a variety of ways, but rotation is the one used here. Analyzing both types of sample segmentation yielded similar results, the maximum area under the curve (AUC) was 0.88 (88 percent) and the DCNN's accuracy is raised to 88.6 percent. As a result, the SVM accuracy increases to 94.2 percent, with an AUC of 0.94. (94 percent). When compared to earlier work under the identical conditions, this is the greatest AUC value.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis using deep learning for use in recommendation systems of various public media applications
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Sentiment Analysis is a method of analyzing text and extracting opinions from it. It’s also known as emotion or opinion extraction, and it’s part of the machine learning as well as data mining categories. There are numerous ways to convey one’s sentiments. It can be articulated in a variety of ways, such as through feelings, making judgments, or expressing one’s vision or insight. Sentiment investigation is the act of detecting, recognizing, and categorizing a user’s emotion or view for any service, such as movies, product issues, events, or any other attribute that can be good, negative, or neutral. This analysis is based on social communication channels such as websites that included ratings, forum conversations, blogs, micro blogs, Twitter, and other social media platforms. The important goal of suggested system is to improvise accuracy and to generate recommendation system using deep learning algorithms.

articleTitle: An IoT based Monitoring System to Detect Animal in the Railway Track using Deep Learning Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Because of the increase in the cost of bus tickets, the railway has become one of the most popular methods of travel. A continual monitoring and examination of railroad tracks is essential in order for the railroad network to operate properly. Presently, the railroad track examination procedure and surveillance system are carried out by hand, which is both time-consuming and inefficient owing to the high likelihood of human mistake occurring throughout the process. Furthermore, since they travel huge distances, it is not practicable to examine and supervise the track on a continual basis using human power. Animal conservation is critical, and a great deal of technology has been used in a variety of methods to accomplish this. Because trains are really a usually applied means of transport in Asian nations, the railway system is even put down across forest regions, interfering with the activities of the local fauna. Larger animals are often struck by trains, and they die as a result. Such tragedies are widespread in India, particularly in the lush borders of the country's southern regions. In order to address the issue, this paper presents a computer skill approach that uses implantable recording devices to locate animals in close proximity to the source of the problem. The use of an inception model for such detection of animals in images and videos is suggested. The suggested approach has been tested and fine-tuned to recognize and identify animals. These very exact and precise models have the ability to alert the trains, maybe saving a valuable life.

articleTitle: Modeling Convolutional Neural Network for Detection of Plant Leaf Spot Diseases
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Farming has come a long way further than directly a system to provide food to an ever-increasing population. The seventieth population of Asian countries depends on agriculture. The identification of plant leaf diseases is typically carried out with the inspection by masters and organic tests. Both techniques are manual, costly and time-consuming. Detecting plant leaf diseases is a challenging task since it involves numerous variables such as genotype, environment, and their interplay. Accurate detection of plant leaf diseases involves a fundamental understanding of functional relativity and the collaborative factors. Deep learning helps in recognition of plant diseases and it provides earlier and timely detection of plant diseases for efficient disease management. It expresses a different infusion that gives systematic and automated detection of diseases. A convolutional neural network model is designed to use for detection of leaf spot diseases in plants. A tomato plant disease dataset has been generated from the local farms of Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh, India. The tomato leaf spot diseases considered for training are Septoria leaf spot, bacterial spot, target spot and leaf mold which are most popular diseases in tomato plants. The average classification accuracy of the proposed model is determined to be 90.6%. For comparative analysis, the proposed CNN model has been experimentally evaluated with Multilayer perceptron classifier model. The proposed model produced an effective average MSE and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> values of 0.016 and 0.991. The MLP model produced less optimal results than the proposed model thus confirming the efficacy of the proposed model in classifying the plant leaf diseases.

articleTitle: A Robust Machine Learning Predictive Model for Maternal Health Risk
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Maternal health refers to the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of mothers throughout all stages of pregnancy, birth, and the postpartum period. Morbidity and death rates during pregnancy are significant health statistics because they provide information about the accessibility of maternal and other medical resources. The main reason of maternal mortality are hemorrhage, high blood pressure, early labor, and abortions that are performed under dangerous conditions. Machine learning algorithms play a significant role in determining maternity health risks. In this paper, Traditional Machine Learning algorithms are applied for maternal health risk prediction. Model performance has potential for improvement, thus a more robust and dependable machine learning model has been proposed to operate even in worst, average, and best scenarios and provide the robust performance by considering the performance of all scenarios. The proposed robust model turns out to be the most efficient robust model among all with an accuracy of 70.21%, which is quite satisfactory when compared to traditionally applied ML Models.

articleTitle: Development of Fruit Cold Storage Monitoring Controller using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Foods products often get fungus during the transportation which degrade biological properties of particular food. T. Matsutake is a fungus that effects the food most such condition will affect the quality of food and their safety which ultimately lead to wastage of foods. Number of food products which are kept in one facility needs unique temperature to be maintained to avoid decay of food to tackle this condition many steps are taken globally such as horticultural ones. Our project is based and developed on real-time monitoring traceability system (RT-MT) by utilizing Internet of Things (IoT) technologies which helps in tracking the environment parameter of cold storage. This paper proposes a system to monitor, which shows the maintenance conditions within the cold chain plants which transmits with IoT. ESP microcontroller which acquire environment parameter such as temperature and humidity via DHT 11 sensor is used and cloud server module which will provide communication data has been utilized. It also includes 3.6 V-2300 mAh battery which will provide a power range of up to 50 hours. The testing and evaluation show that RM-TM will monitor humidity and temperature and carbon dioxide fluctuation in cold chain. Data collection can be used to increase transparency of cold chain and more efficiently control quality. The work intends to design a hardware system in owner’s house or industry that monitor temperature utilization of cold storage, it is developed to calculate the consumption of energy. A server with appropriate channels to monitor each device's energy consumption has been created. The acquired data gets upload on the server at user end. The problems are analysed and solution offered consists of device which collect the data from sensor in RT-MT and transmit the data to cloud server. From the platform, client can visualize the data in real time on dashboard at any place.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Fault Detection in Induction Motor using Thermal Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In thermal imaging research, the majority of the work involves assessing external faults and detecting failures in equipment's outer parts. This work presents a condition monitoring system for assessing internal faults to detect failures in an induction motor using infrared thermal imaging. A dataset consisting of 540 infrared thermal images of an induction motor, which includes five faulty conditions and one healthy condition, is considered for analysis. The histogram and textural features are extracted from the thermal images after the data is acquired, processed, and analyzed. Next, images are classified into hot and cold, and the region of interest is located by applying a sliding window technique with an auto-thresholding function and ground truth. Machine learning classifiers such as decision trees and random forest and ensemble learners such as Ada boost and gradient boosting trees are used to detect and classify faults in both hot and cold conditions. To examine the performance of each classifier, evaluation metrics are used.

articleTitle: Ensemble Machine Learning (Grid Search & Random Forest) based Enhanced Medical Expert Recommendation System for Diabetes Mellitus Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: "Araetus" was the person who coined the term "Diabetes" and later on the word "mellitus" which means honey-sweet was added to it by Thomas Willis in the year 1675 after noticing the sweet nature of the blood and urine of the patients. Currently, it is one of the most developing lethal maladies throughout the world to mankind. The number of diabetes people being reported is increasing every day and also annually it costs a lot of money to treat people who are suffering from diabetes mellitus (DM). So initially, the idea of creating a system that is capable of predicting the type of diabetes, and recommending diet, the quantity of insulin to be taken, and the types of physical workouts for the user was only focussed. Later on, this system is designed to propose the benefits for diabetic patients which help them to fight their type of diabetes. This system can make personalized recommendations based on their type and status of diabetes. Here, an ensemble machine learning algorithm is used to predict whether a person is diabetic or not and what type of diabetes the person has. Diabetes mellitus is characterized by pancreatic insufficiency and an increased blood sugar level. As a result, a person with diabetes must be saved by controlling the difficulties of DM. To successfully forecast the presence of DM and to lessen the severity of DM outcomes, a predictive model is necessary. The primary goal of this work is to create and develop a DM prediction model that uses machine learning techniques to operate as a decision-making system to predict and recommend.

articleTitle: YOLO based Efficient Vigorous Scene Detection And Blurring for Harmful Content Management to Avoid Children’s Destruction
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Parental control is one of the most difficult security challenges with mobile devices. Large multimedia items, such as high-definition photos or video streaming, may be received and processed by modern devices. From purchasing to learning, Covid allowed us to accomplish everything digitally. Mostly Children are taking their studies online, and some of them are making good use of it. However, advertisements and other distracting items are sabotaging the student’s career. Parental control over their children’s mobile devices is now possible with the help of mobile device software, which allows parents to restrict which apps their children can use while also keeping tabs on their children’s Short Messaging Service, call records, Multimedia Messaging Service, and other bargain under surveillance. This program’s capacity to monitor bullying is another aspect worth pointing out. This device is capable of detecting nude content, weapons, alcohol, and drugs. The suggested system runs on an Android smartphone. Every 10 seconds, the system grabs a picture from the android screen, processes it by recognizing the objects taught, and sends the obtained image as an email attachment to their parents When specific things are recognized, a popup box is displayed to prevent the youngsters from accessing the material. The training accuracy is 87.2 percent, the average precision score is 0.84, f1 score is 0.8 and the loss is 0% indicating that the prediction was flawless. The designed solution was successfully incorporated into the Android system, yielding the desired outcomes.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Malware Detection Approach using Machine Learning and Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: On the basis of current analysis, the fact that cybersecurity has become a major issue with the advancement of technology cannot be ignored. Malware is one of those serious security adversaries, which can easily evade the prevalent traditional methods of detection such as Signature Matching. Since malware is constantly evolving, it is a herculean task to identify new malware using traditional methods. Machine learning models are more effective in identifying malware. Here, the performance of Artificial Intelligence based models such as Random forest, K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN) and XGBoost with and without the effect of appropriate feature selection algorithms are compared and discussed. Feature selection algorithms which are used here are namely Boruta and Analysis Of Variance (ANOVA). Random Forest leverages Boruta as the feature selector and additionally a feature ranker whereas KNN is coupled with the feature selection algorithm ANOVA. Feature selection is nifty, as it reduces the dimensionality of the dataset significantly. Some redundant features can be successfully eliminated through feature selection without human intervention. Feature selection also reduces overfitting and furthermore renders the model to be more explainable and interpretable. The performance of the mentioned models coupled with feature selection are weighed-up using performance metrics. The varying importance of different features for a malware classification of a Windows portable executable (PE) file over time is also studied. Since malware evolve over time it’s important to know the variable responsible for it. Though many machine learning models are able to identify malware it’s important that they aid in explainability as well. Thus the paper focuses upon the models and features that additionally improve explainability. The results obtained through experiments show that, with as minimum as 27 features of a portable executable file, a machine learning model can detect malware effectively.

articleTitle: Design of IoT and ML enabled Framework for Water Quality Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Globally, the quality of water is declining due to multiple factors such as urbanization, industrialization, agricultural waste disposal, climatic and seasonal variations. As per a study conducted by the World Health Organization (WHO), around 144 million people in the world directly collect and consume untreated surface water from ponds, lakes, rivers, and streams. One key challenge is that the community members are unaware of the dynamic variations in water quality and its impacts on their health, and this demands the need for systems and processes that would provide the opportunity for community members to be aware of these issues. To cater to this demand, this work proposes the design of an IoT system integrated with machine learning algorithms for classifying block panchayat based on water quality index (WQI) and monitoring the quality of water. This will contribute to improving the water resource management and governance by integrating a machine learning approach for predicting location-specific WQI based on current water quality and seasonal factors for the study area. The district of Alappuzha in the state of Kerala is selected for the study as several areas of this district are below sea level and the water sustainability in this area is affected by agricultural practices, tourism, seawater intrusion in summer, and flooding during the monsoon season. Currently, this study area lacks a continuous monitoring system which can help in effective water resource management. Based on the results of statistical analysis, a platform integrated for continuous real-time monitoring of water sources, and mapping of communities into WQI categories has been proposed. In this work, the historic data from 2010 to 2017 is utilized for deriving the community level classification based on the water quality index.

articleTitle: IoT and Co-Operative Communication Enabled Healthcare Devices - A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: IoT devices are increased as there is constant growth in internet dependable devices. These devices can be able to make contact with the outer world and with the people using a wide range of sensors that, by digitizing certain qualities of interest and experiencing reality as a consequence. It can provide a tremendous amount of data. All of this data is then shared with other devices, as well as other programmes and infrastructures across the network. IoT is built up on the idea of a continually changing the dynamic world integrating the WSNs. IoT applications are in healthcare monitoring, which are combined sensor technology with proprietary communication protocols, they have improved communication between doctors and patients, resulting in high-quality medical treatment. This is accomplished by using a sensor network with no wires system to monitor patients in real time. For predictive analytics on sensor data is obtained via different channels of communication, several machine learning approaches are addressed. The reliability of the Internet of Things in Healthcare architecture development is examined in this study by using a cooperative communication system with a relay mechanism. In healthcare outcomes, the machine learning analytical approach allows sickness diagnosis. This article about the IoT in healthcare and the several data science algorithms utilized makes use of a variety of literature evaluations. This article also discussed the hardware difficulties of integrating cooperative communication. In the framework of cooperative communication, the current technologies and data sources are employed in healthcare analytics are further outlined. Integration of cloud and fog technologies with IoT data modelling has also been suggested.

articleTitle: IoT based Driver Assist System with Application of OpenCV and Python
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Nowadays, considerable number of road accidents are being reported worldwide. Every individual has to be very cautious while they are travelling irrespective of the mode of transportation. Accidents can never be avoided, especially nowadays road accidents are increasing in number day by day. There are a couple of factors which contribute to road accidents which includes speeding, drunken driving, weariness, and some other factors also contribute to the same. Safety is the first and foremost concern in everything. Whether its driver’s or passengers’ safety both matters. The major cause for vehicle crash is drowsiness or Fatigue of the driver. To get away from this, there is a great need for a Fatigue detection system, which is necessary to alert the driver if the person seems to be detected with drowsiness or any of the slight signs. The seriousness of accidents can be controlled to some extent if the vehicle’s safety features are taken into deepest concern. This work comes up with a proposed method for detecting accidents and safety of the passengers throughout the journey. The tools which are used to implement this work includes OpenCV and python. Adding to that, detection of sunglasses is done using algorithms including Haar Cascades. This proposed work comes forward with face and Fatigue detection along with pedestrian and detection.

articleTitle: Forest Fire Detection using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Every year, approximately 70,000 wildfires occur around the world. Forest fires can have a variety of negative effects on forest cover, soil, tree development, vegetation, and general flora and fauna. Fires destroy several hectares of forest and leave behind ash, rendering it unfit for vegetation growth. Animal habitats are destroyed by the heat created by the fire. Preventing fire disasters and saving people’s lives and property requires early detection of fires before they become catastrophic. These forest fires must be detected and put out as early as possible. In this project a computer vision based deep learning model is proposed that can detect and alert in-case of forest fires. The model which is used here is called MobileNet Architecture which employs depth-wise separable convolutions and has greater advantages than using other currently existing models. The model is trained from a dataset that was scrapped from the internet. The computer vision model is built utilizing the packages in Python 3 such as NumPy, OpenCV, Pillow, Matplotlib, and TensorFlow. This method is created by training and testing the model to identify failures and establish recovery strategies. As a result, these computer vision-based systems can provide a warning at an early stage of fire, which is critical for forest fire early warning.

articleTitle: Machine Comprehension System in Tamil and English based on BERT
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Question Answering is a part of information retrieval. It is a task of machine-reading comprehension and presents a medium to assess the ability of machines to understand human language. A question-and-answer system is preferable to search engines that return a collection of documents. Any question answering system's high level design consists of three primary components: Question analysis, retrieval of context, answer is being extracted. With an availability of training resources and Transformer-based models trained on huge English corpora, the precision and accuracy of English Question Answering systems has increased dramatically over the years. Such big datasets, however, are not available for low-resource languages like Tamil. For low-resource languages, multilingual BERT (mBERT) models are utilized. The translations from the same language family is used to supplement the available data and fine-tune the mBERT-based model. Cross-lingual learning uses zero, and few-shot techniques applied to transfer the knowledge of a QA model trained on many source examples to a given target language with fewer training data. Pre-training and fine-tuning of the model improves performance, according to model tests.

articleTitle: Design of Secured Multifactor Fingerprint Authentication System for Bank Employee
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Web banking and other financial administrations nowadays have turned into essential applications in the web, and these administrations are being offered by every bank around the globe. With the assistance of this administration, clients can make any exchange without going to the bank. Thus, for these web-based administrations there ought to be exceptionally close security and checking, for keeping away from the tricks and cheats. Therefore, there ought to be a framework for every client in the specific bank, and this venture gives this component to the banks so that banks can make their service better. In this exploration, a login and enlistment page for the banking framework is designed so that every client can log in according to the multi verification framework. There are various stages for login and each progression is significant. Stage 1 is the enrollment page in which bank can enlist the new client with the assistance of the fundamental data given by the client. Stage 2 login page permits the client to log in to the bank site, and stage 3 is the OTP confirmation where an OTP is sent to the given mobile number, and when the OTP is entered, the financial administration page is reached. Stage 4 is the unique identification mark check where the client needs to place his finger on the sensor and if the fingerprint matches, the client is checked and the login process is completed. With the assistance of this multi-confirmation process, the banking can be made 100% secure.

articleTitle: A Synoptic Survey on Personality Prediction System using MBTI
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This survey paper presents a Personality Prediction System based on Meyer-Briggs-Type-Indicator (MBTI) that computes and identifies the personality traits of an individual using a qualified machine learning technique. This system helps individuals to break their curiosity about knowing themselves and it is highly used as a tool for psychological profiling. Personality prediction is influential in building an individual's confidence and helps to tone oneself for the foreseen challenges of their life. For instance, this could help people identify their interests and hidden skills. This system gives a clear overview of them and will help to guide and choose one's career path. Though there have been many personality prediction systems in the past, this system stands ahead of them by using digital questionnaire forms to process MBTI trait cards and its method of digesting the data using machine learning which is capable of handling dynamic input. To build this system, relevant literature papers were reviewed and analyzed, to build a different system but to provide the best results that could be compared and examined.

articleTitle: Stagchain – A Steganography based Application Working on a Blockchain Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Communication plays a vital role in human life. But in the case of sharing confidential information, there are many issues of concern, such as the lack of confidentiality, authenticity and integrity. Steganography is one of the methods used for conventional covert communication, but it sends the information via an insecure channel. Even though the hackers entering into the channel cannot decrypt the original data, information such as recipient details and communication time are exposed and the communication can be disrupted or hijacked. To address this problem, "Stag-chain," a blockchain-based design that combines an effective steganographic technique with the Advance Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm and the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) Protocol (decentralized cloud storage), is introduced. Furthermore, the image file will be available on the cloud for retrieval only for a limited period after which it will be replaced by a normal image. Since the data is sent as a transaction in Ethereum, it is almost impossible to manipulate or retrieve that data, hence ensuring data integrity and data security. The aim of the said scheme is to develop an app that will ensure data confidentiality, establish a secure channel to transmit data, enhance data security and protect the data from unauthorized access or manipulation.

articleTitle: Improvement of QoS and Selection of Cluster Head using RSL Algorithm with Multipath Routing Protocol in MANET
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The use of Mobile Ad hoc Networks (MANET) apps has been deployed in numerous regions that are inaccessible to humans. In sensor networks, however, routing remains a major issue since timely delivery of data to the base station is critical. Data transmission has been more dependable and scalable in recent years thanks to Multipath Routing. The concept of Quality of Service (QoS)-based routing is relatively new, with just a few protocols addressing it. The QoS is addressed in this paper using the clustering approach. Each cluster has a cluster head which is picked using the Random Selected Leader (RSL) based optimizer algorithm in this article. Using the Cluster Heads, the suggested method selects reliable pathways for data transmission based on factors such as energy consumption, latency, and congestion index costs. In contrast to current QoS Centric protocols, the suggested protocol leverages the optimal amount of pathways for data transmission and improves the network lifetime by deploying energy-optimized Cluster Heads. Simulated environments are used to test the proposed protocol's performance. According to simulation results, the suggested protocol surpasses current protocols in terms of throughput and network life.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation on Cross Layered Routing Protocol in Cognitive Radio Networks (CRN)
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The Cognitive Radio Network (CRN) has been developed to fulfill the high needs of future wireless communication systems (5G). Rapid use of wireless communication services has made a huge demand for spectrum and bandwidth allocation. Proper spectrum sharing and efficient usage of spectrum are the two ways to meet the necessary demand. This Cognitive Radio Technology makes use of these two ways to improvise the bandwidth utilization and achieve better quality of services. To maximize the spectrum utilization, the Cognitive Radio is adapted with various other combining techniques. By properly designed with Dynamic Spectrum Access (DSA), multihop cognitive radio is the best approach to provide better bandwidth. This DSA addresses major challenges like spectrum awareness, quality route establishment, route maintenance and node mobility. Gravitational Search Genetic Algorithm (GSGA) protocol has been developed for the betterment of speed of convergence without compromising the accuracy of the predictor model. Conventional approaches, although improved channel usage, lead to a rise in overhead as the number of nodes grows. To overcome these drawbacks, the proposed GSGA protocol has been designed that efficiently utilizes the channel and predicts the availability of the channel. When it comes to throughput and stability, simulations show that the proposed cross-layered routing protocol is superior.

articleTitle: An Effective Gas and Oil Leakage Detection System over Industrial Environment using Internet of Things Assistance
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Mesh, ad-hoc, and hierarchical sensor networks have all been used extensively throughout the years to gather ambient data from various structural installations. Sensing systems that have their nodes in an orderly fashion are referred to as linear sensing systems. Conventional sensing networks typically aim to run the network as a lattice or informal architecture in a dense population throughout instance, leading to problems with efficient management of resources and networking. When using linear sensor networks, it is necessary to handle recovery from gaps, which occur when one node cannot communicate with another node on either side of the gap, and the creation of a route for data transmission with intelligence. A linear sensor node implementation request for piping systems using a specially made security measurement supplemented by methods used to solve internet backbone creation, release interference recognition, but also transmission of high-priority messages in a consistent manner while keeping the firm operational at all times is suggested to handle these problems. It is possible to detect and locate leaks in a system that uses little energy and high data dependability as well as low latencies, while comparing the suggested system to other systems demonstrates its usefulness.

articleTitle: Early Diabetes Prediction using Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and hypertension account for nearly half of all early deaths every year. Diabetes is a disease that necessitates continuous monitoring of blood sugar levels, particularly glucose, in order to effectively mitigate the emerging health complications. Self-management of the disease, particularly maintaining glucose levels in the blood within a specific range, is critical for treatment. This involves actively monitoring blood glucose and insulin levels, as well as managing diet and physical activity. Diabetes advancements and self-administration applications have made it easier for patients to gain access to more relevant information. The ability of Machine Learning (ML) techniques to solve complex tasks in dynamic environments and with dynamic data has contributed to its success in the study of diseases such as diabetes. This research study has attempted to design and develop a personal healthcare system, which can use the data generated from daily activities and other significant parameters to monitor the blood glucose level and provide proper report representation online. The Machine Learning (ML) technique has been used to detect non-communicable diseases at an early stage. The proposed research study has surveyed previous relevant literatures in order to understand the approaches used previously for the detection or presence of disease in the human body. There are various methods to determine blood glucose levels non-invasively, but a universally acceptable method with good accuracy and precision is not yet available. This paper emphasized about using Random Forest, a supervised machine learning algorithm to determine the probability of occurrence of diabetes mellitus to take precautions accordingly.

articleTitle: Survey on Smart Agriculture a Roadmap for India: Role of IoT, AI
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: India has the second largest share of agricultural land in the world with more than half of the available workforce employed in agriculture and allied fields. The gross value added to economy still stays below 17%. Largely the farming practices are governed by statistical data and traditional know-how. To maximize the yield and value addition the concentration needs to be on quantitative approaches backed by technology. Owing to the popularity of Internet of Things (IoT) and cloud computing most of the industrial practices are adopting these technologies to improve the outcome. This work aims to highlight the potential of IoT in Indian agricultural context backed by a through literature review on sensors, Communication topologies, data analytics & decision making through Artificial Intelligence (AI) for IOT. Furthermore, a roadmap model for Smart Agriculture in India is proposed considering the framework and facilities available.

articleTitle: Wearable Sensor based Authentications using Red-Tacton
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Biometric identification using smart wearable devices is becoming more popular. They will, however, continue to provide authentication services to the fitness and medical industries. If someone claims to be who they say they are, biometric authentication can be used to verify their identification. The physical or behavioural attributes of an individual are compared to a database using biometric authentication technology to ensure their legitimacy. If the two sets of biometric data match, the user is confirmed to be real. Access to computers, buildings, and other electronic equipment is commonly restricted via biometric authentication. The fingerprints or retinal scans of a person are used in biometric identification. Smart sensor-based wearable authentications have been evaluated using Red-tacton in this work. The sensors that measure heartbeat, temperature, and breathing events are sent to the PiC microcontroller. The RS232 level converter is used to convert TTL.

articleTitle: ROS based Obstacle Detection Robot using Ultrasonic Sensor and FMCW RADAR
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the field of robotics, integration has been one of the major challenges due to the complex architecture of hardware and software. The extended scale and scope of the robots make the robot software development complex. Robotic Operating System (ROS) solves the problem by serving as a flexible framework for robot software development. With easy access to code, robots with ROS became reachable to more around the world. This paper proposes the implementation of an autonomous mobile robot based on ROS. The system utilizes an ultrasonic sensor and also exploits the possibility of using BGT60TR13C, a Frequency Modulated Continuous-wave (FMCW) radar sensor for obstacle detection. All the tasks have been performed on a four-wheeled cart mobile robot with Raspberry pi pre-installed with ROS, ultrasonic sensor, radar, and motor driver. The ultrasonic sensor and radar can detect the obstacles and calculate the range of the obstacle. This range information is used to decide the movement direction and signals are sent to the motor driver through the Raspberry pi. The robot can move around the indoor environment using the sensors and an onboard single-board computer.

articleTitle: An Integration of Deep Learning Approach for prediction of Consumer Reviews using Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: There is a massive increase in consumer reviews posted on social media, both in terms of the volume of evaluations and their relevance. This is why sentiment analysis is becoming increasingly popular in a wide range of contexts, including politics, social issues, and current events. For a number of corporate applications, the analysis of social media user reviews is critical. Because social media makes it so simple to obtain public sentiment from around the world, this method is better suited for sentiment mining. With the hybrid technique of two deep constructions, the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and the Long Short Term Memory (LSTTM), this article examines airline industry service and movie reviews (LSTM). The local feature selection power of CNN has been well documented, whereas the sequential text analysis prowess of LSTM has been well documented as well. In sentiment analysis, the suggested CNN-LSTM model primarily aims to achieve two goals. First, it can easily be scaled up to handle large amounts of social media data, and second, unlike traditional machine learning algorithm’s, it is not domain-specific. Two review datasets from different fields have been used to train a perfect that can handle all kinds of dependences in a post. This ensemble model outperforms other deep learning algorithms in accuracy and other limits, as shown by the results in the experiments.

Author Keywords: Long Short Term Memory Sentiment Analysis

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on Wireless Body Area Network - Technologies, Challenges, Application and Energy Saving Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A Wireless Body Area Sensor Network (WBASN) is becoming a routine part of everyday life due to its versatility of uses, particularly in the field of medical care for continuous patient monitoring, providing clinical assistance in patient care, and to improve the quality of patient’s lives. Due to the low power battery capacity of biosensors comprising in WBAN, making replacement of batteries poses a challenge, specifically for sensors implanted inside the human body. Also, these networks produce a large amount of sensory information, which requires the network to balance the load to perform optimally and last longer. This review article gives an outline about energy management of wearable or non-wearable sensors, load balancing, routing, and security issues in wearable Remote Body Area Network (RBAN). It also highlights the fundamental issues, energy maintaining challenges in such delicate sensitive BAN, and a wide scope of Internet of Things (IoT)-based applications in the field of clinical, sports, lifestyle, and diversion. Various energy-improving routing algorithms utilized in WBAN to profit the networks Quality of Service (QOS) and the correspondence advancements utilized in associating wearable WBAN in the IoTapplication are also discussed in detail.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Fruit Classification and Grading Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Traditional methods for fruit grading are based on sensory or psychometric evaluation, which is costly and time-consuming. Different approaches were developed for different fruit like Dates, Apple, Mango, Tomato, and Mulberry based on their features like shape, color, Freshness, acidity, and some other methods also include cellular level analysis and Classification. The most prevalent traits used to detect diseases, ripeness, and fruit class are color, texture, and morphological characteristics. Agriculture automation is used to boost production and quality and promote economic growth. The techniques have evolved to grade fruits in cost-effective, less time-consuming using computer vision and machine learning algorithms that include Artificial Neural Networks and Support Vector Machine. ML techniques, spectrometric sensors, and non-invasive sensing provided better results. In this article, different Machine Learning and Deep Learning methods used along with traditional designs are considered and analyzed. Their mathematical model and algorithms are interpreted, and deep analysis is done.

articleTitle: Face Mask Identification using Transfer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Coronavirus (COVID-19) has become the major health issues in the current scenario. Symptoms start with the common cold and end with fever. These viruses affect the respiratory part of the human body. Hence, wearing of face mask is essential. Usage of masks in public places has become mandatory. Due to the significance of the face mask in public places, a transfer learning approach has been proposed for the identification of face masks. The system comprises feature extraction and classification. For feature extraction, transfer learning is used and for classification, Machine Learning is used (ML). Mobile Net and VGG 16 (Visual geometric Group) is used as feature extractor, similarly, SVM and Random Forest are used as a classifier. Performance metrics are evaluated to determine the highest accuracy from the resultant model. The high optimal model is determined by comparing its accuracy. Of the four models, VGG-16_SVM gives high accuracy of 89% and Mobile Net_ random Forest gives the second most accuracy of 87%. Out of all VGG-16,_ SVM gives the best classification output, which will be the most optimum model for face mask identification. The dataset is procured from Masked Face - Net dataset, it consists of human faces with correct and incorrect mask data based on Flicker-Faces-HQ (FFHQ).

articleTitle: Improving Visibility of images - Underwater by Modeling of Back Light and Optimization of the Transmission Map
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Light absorption in the water medium causes degradation and distortion of under-water images. This study uses the technique is image restoration. It restores the images captured and adjusts the color gradient level of the images of underwater. Underwater photographs are not decorated and do not hide naturally. Therefore, to avoid this, various image restoration methods are used to retrieve the original image. This results suggest that the proposed approach has significantly enhanced the visibility and reliability of images in underwater. Two parameters are considered for the image enhancement that is BckL (Background Light) and TrMap (Transmission Map). Color and Contrast adjustment can be developed for the enhancement of the underwater image. The proposed method is developed by enhancing the color and contrast of the image by using the annotation of image manually. A database with the annotated image (ABckL) compared with the histogram model of underwater image statistical analysis is performed. TrMap is estimated roughly for the R channel with the new dark underwater (NDUI) images via a statistical model. Light attention (LA) and underwater reverse saturation (URS) are applied to NDUI to modify the course of the R channel to improve the image enhancement. The difference between red Channel (R) and channel- G-B estimates the TrMap of G-B channel. The white balance method at the end stages improves the color and contrast of the image. Compared with other methods, the proposed method produced has achieved high accuracy, short computation time, color improvement.

articleTitle: Face Mask Detection and Face Recognition of Unmasked People in Organizations
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the onset of the global pandemic of COVID-19 and with the infection rates on the rise, face masks have become a necessity in public spaces to prevent further spread of the virus. Therefore, it is necessary to develop a system which enforces the need to wear a facemask in public places and identify the ones who are without it. This paper describes a face mask detection and face recognition system. Masked faces are detected using Convolutional Neural Networks and individuals without a face mask are recognized using the LBPH algorithm. The models use OpenCV and TensorFlow and are trained and tested. For doing so, two sets of datasets are used, where the majority of the images are obtained from the Kaggle dataset. 20% of the images are considered for training purposes and other 80% is for testing. The experimental results have confirmed an average face mask detection and face recognition rate of 99%. Accuracy and loss plots for the proposed model are compared with the existing model. Testing for mask detection and facial recognition of masked and unmasked faces are done elaborately.

articleTitle: Development of Vehicle Safety Control for the anticipation of Accidents using Intelligence process
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Road accidents are due to lot of factors. They may occur due to human errors, road conditions and vehicle condition. This paper is about exploring about three parameters which are the major reasons of deaths. Those three parameters are loss of pressure in tyres, drowsiness of driver and detection of nearest vehicles. In order to avoid accidents related to these parameters, a system has been implemented which can minimize the accidents to maximum extent. This system contains three types of sensors which are useful for the detection of those three parameters. Flex sensor is used to calculate the amount of loss of pressure from the tyre, Eye blink sensor is used for the detection of drowsiness of the driver and Ultrasonic sensor is used to detect the nearer vehicles. This research study utilizes an Arduino UNO, which contains a microcontroller ATmega 328p to monitor all the three parameters such as pressure, drowsiness and nearer vehicles based on the outputs from the respective sensors and sends the output to the buzzer and liquid crystal display. The experimental results showed that the proposed vehicle safety control for the anticipation of accidents achieves better testing accuracy of 80%. Inshot the proposed method is an effective method for the prevention of accidents.

articleTitle: Intersection Collision Warning Using Wireless System Module via Cellular-Vehicle to Everything Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The proposed work discussed in the paper aims to design and develop an application for providing intersection collision warning (ICW) to the vehicles. The main problem faced at the intersection point is the chance of occurrence of collision between vehicles due to careless mistakes in driving and violation in following the traffic rules. The proposed application can pre-vent the collisions at the intersection point using cellular vehicle to everything technology (C-V2X) which enables communication between vehicles.
