The problem of traffic congestion in the urban and rural arterials is increasing day by day and it is very difficult to handle it at the intersection point when multiple vehicles are approaching the intersection point. The system uses C-V2X technology to communicate with the vehicle in vicinity, and shares information such as position, speed, heading etc. When vehicles are approaching to the intersection point, the application alerts the driver using beep sound, display or light effect, low speed or vibration on steering. In this way the vehicle to vehicle collision at the intersection point can be avoided thus ensuring safety to the driver and other travellers.

articleTitle: A Ring Toss game-based Optimized Routing Protocol for Optimal Path Selection in MANET
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Nodes in a MANET connect using radio waves, which makes it an ad hoc network. Despite its many advantages, the MANET suffers from several drawbacks, including a lack of dedicated network infrastructure and an unstable topology. Route failures occurred because of the network’s uncontrolled node movements that increased energy consumption and delay, as well as limited the node’s lifetime. In this research work, these problems are solved using the Ring Toss Game-Based Optimization (RTGBO) algorithm. RTGBO’s major goal is to build an algorithm that mimics the comportment of players and the regulations of the ring toss game. The RTGBO algorithm has no control parameters as its major characteristic. Mathematical models of the suggested algorithm for implementing RTGBO are provided. According to path optimality, delay, throughput, and longevity of the network, the suggested method’s performance is evaluated. The results proved that the proposed RTGBO achieved 420s of network lifetime, 2.4s of end-to-end delay, and consumed 12J of energy for node 300.

articleTitle: Smart IoT based Human Well-being Monitoring in Health Care System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In hospitals and other health facilities, the usage of medical monitoring systems has skyrocketed, and governments throughout the globe are becoming more concerned about the potential dangers of medical monitoring systems on the move. Telemedicine has been facilitated by the emergence of Internet of Things (IoT) technology in the healthcare industry. As part of this research, a patient's health and room conditions may be monitored in real-time using an IoT-based smart healthcare system. ESP32 is fitted with a variety of biosensors that assess heart rate, body oxygen level, and temperature. An internet of things (IOT) application allows physicians and caregivers to access patient data from distant locations. In the event of an emergency, caretakers and doctors can be contacted via smartphone alerts.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis for Chronic Disease Prediction using Various Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Early detection of chronic disease is crucial for increasing patient quality of life and lowering treatment costs. As a result, being able to predict these illnesses is critical. This study aims to identify chronic disease datasets (diabetes, heart disease, kidney disease, and breast cancer) in order to predict the beginning of the condition and provide patients with appropriate treatment options. The main purpose of this project is to use Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques including Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbor, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Neural Network to predict chronic disease in individual patients. Among these several algorithms, the algorithm that gives more accuracy to predict chronic diseases in individual patients can be identified. Finally, an experimental study of the proposed work with various algorithms has been demonstrated in this paper. Chronic diseases such as heart disease, kidney disease, breast cancer, and diabetes are all predicted using these methods.

articleTitle: EEG Signal Analysis for Emotional Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) uses electrodes to assess neuronal activity in various brain areas. articleTitle: A Critical Review on the Low Power SIC MOSFET based Current Fed Inverter used in Surface Hardening Application

abstract: Generally, an induction heating system is composed of a power source (or inverter), tank circuit (or work head), and a work coil. The amount of current flowing through the coil in an industrial context is frequently significant enough to necessitate water cooling. As a result, a water-cooling system is included in the conventional setup. The power supply converts the current from the AC line into an alternating current that is tuned to match the capacitance, inductance, and resistance of the work head, coil, and part. The induction generator, along with the induction coil and the workpiece is considered as the most significant component of an induction heating system. Most of the time, this type of equipment is evaluated based on how frequently it operates and how much power it can generate at its maximum output. The amount of power required is determined by the type of material, work piece size, required amount of temperature rise, and the time required to reach the temperature. The size of the work item that needs to be heated is one such factor that influences how often the induction heating system runs. Larger workpieces benefit from a lower frequency (>10 kHz) and better heat penetration when compared to smaller workpieces, which require a higher frequency (>50 kHz) for efficient heating. The amount of heat lost from a heated workpiece increases as the work piece's temperature rises. As the temperature rises, the work piece's radiation and convection losses become more significant. When the temperature is high, insulation is frequently utilized to prevent heat loss and the quantity of power required from the induction system. The design aspects of standard induction surface hardening is examined in this article, as well as the power supply of a SiC MMOSFET-based current-fed inverter. With the advancement in power semiconductor wide bandgap semiconductor switching technology and improvement in load resonant inverter topology, it has become possible to achieve high efficient induction heating systems for application of surface hardening in today's automobile and metal industries. Surface hardening is the coupled electromagnetic thermal and metallurgical process to increase wear resistance of the specific portion of the magnetic or nonmagnetic workpiece material. Nowadays, solid-state current fed inverter topology has gained more attention when compared to voltage fed inverter. Hence, a significant research effort has been made in this research article to examine its power, control design, and performance aspects through a critical literature review and identification of research gaps defining future recommendations and motive for the researchers working in this domain.

articleTitle: Biomedical Image Security Based on 2D and 3D Chaotic Systems

abstract: Recently, identifying abnormalities via medical images became vital. As these images are transferred across the IoMT network, they require high safety. articleTitle: Activity Oriented Malicious Node Identification for Packet Drop Attack in WSN

abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) have become increasingly popular in various areas. Attacks on WSN can occur in a variety of ways depending on the type of harmful behaviour. In this proposed work, the major aspect is to identify a fake node in the organization. By utilizing normal circumstances, an assault and a malevolent hub in the organization can be distinguished. articleTitle: Forwarding Factor with Acknowledgement Routing Protocol for Opportunistic IoT Network

abstract: Opportunistic Network is a subset of Delay Tolerant Network. Opportunistic IoT Network is the combination of Opportunistic Network and Internet of Things. They differ from mobile ad hoc networks where always require an end-to-end path between the source and the destination, while in the Opportunistic Network the nodes are mobile, and message may be exchanged through dynamic routes. Therefore, routing in opportunistic networks is way more difficult than traditional networks. In Opportunistic networks message routing is built based on connection between the nodes that influences according to their mobility, technique called Store-Carry-and-Forward and it forward messages to the neighbor nodes. For sending the message to the end node, the protocol moves the message to the intermediate nearest nodes. This paper proposes a Forwarding Factor with Acknowledgement routing protocol, which finds potential forwarders by keeping track of the interactions between nodes and thus controls the number of copies through the networks. Further, after successful delivery to the target node, it sends an acknowledgement to the source node using same technique. It was expected that the Forwarding Factor with Acknowledgement protocol outperformed the traditional protocols like Epidemic and Prophet with a fairly low communication overhead and more delivery ratio.

articleTitle: NB-IoT: BLER and Throughput Analysis in Downlink Physical Shared Channel

abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) specifies a network of connected physical objects that are equipped with sensors, processing components, software and transceivers to exchange data in real time over the internet. IoT consists of mechanical and digital machines and may contain real time health monitoring data for remote connectivity and processing. The IoT devices are considerably constrained by resources with an imperative reduction in power consumption, processing speed and computation. To support the various requirements of IoT, various low-power radio communication technologies are developed recently. Narrow Band IoT (NB-IoT) is a cutting edge low-power wide area network (LPWAN) wireless communication technology and part of 5G regime that is standardized in 3GPP release 13. Additionally, NB-IoT and LTE share a number of common features that enables NB-IoT to share the same infrastructure as LTE. NB-IoT supports a high-density communication with an increase in the coverage. NB-IoT is a promising technology that has gained considerable research interest recently. Additionally, NB-IoT is implemented in various novel fields with smart cities, smart inventory management, smart agriculture being a few prominent applications. Although, 3GPP release 13 standardizes the NB-IoT features, it remains an open research problem to analyze the performance of NB-IoT under various channel and signaling conditions. In the current work, the features of NB-IoT including the deployment modes are discussed. Additionally, the channels and signals of NB-IoT are summarized and discussed. Further, extensive simulations are performed to determine the Block Error Rate (BLER) and throughput of Narrow-Band Physical Downlink Channel under different signaling conditions, Number of Repetitions (Nrep) and changed Transport Block Size (TBS). A reduction in BLER is noted with the increase in number of repetitions as well with increased SNR. The results are presented in a tabular form for better clarity and analyzed to identify the superior communication conditions in NB-IoT.

Considering the issues and demanding situations faced through instructional establishments in studying people overall performance and enhancing their instructional management, the diverse automated studying strategies have been examined. In this work, more Research contribution were reviewed and evaluated in revealing alternative ways for evaluating students' educational attainment to improve quality and support students in attaining remarkable achievements in their academics. The most typical applications of educational data mining encompass: enhancing the study process, intensifying course completion, assisting students in curriculum selection, student profiling, classifying factors that predispose to dropout, student targeting, curriculum planning, predicting student performance, and as a support for decision-making at the time of student enrolment. Predictive analytics is a machine learning and data mining method that is commonly utilized in educational data mining, to foresee expected future trends, events, and behaviors based on prior data. As a result of data mining algorithms, academic establishments will be able to make people academic outcomes accessible in aims to enhance the quality of learning they deliver.

articleTitle: Fruits Quality Detection using Deep Learning Models: A Meta- Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Deep learning has progressed significantly in recent years, making it an ideal choice for image processing applications. Recognition and classification of fruits using deep learning are considered as the most promising techniques for commercial and agricultural applications. Despite this, the researchers are still having difficulty in distinguishing fruits due to their similar colour, shape, and size. This research study intends to address some of the existing challenges by developing a novel framework for fruit identification and classification. Deep learning models such as U-Net, VGG19, and ResNet are used in this work to train and test these models. Here, two sets of data were used: pre-processed and augmented dataset. ResNet performs well with 98% accuracy on the initial set of data, but it consumes more time to compute. As a result, the deep learning models could recognize and classify 122 different types of fruits in real time. However, image augmentation will have no effect on the models' performance.

articleTitle: Solar Aware Routing with Super Capacitors to Balance Energy in Unequal Clusters for WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: WSN is one among the predominant innovations that uprises in the recent decades. LEACH protocol is utilized for routing in order to form the clusters in an efficient manner. In case if the network is split into unequal clusters, then the system may become unbalanced in packet delivery. Formation of small clusters collapses that particular cluster after few rounds due to lack of energy, making a part of the network completely drained out and blacked out. In order to balance the network, a novel protocol is proposed which makes the system more efficient by making an additional energy source available to the existing system. Replacing a battery by super capacitor increases the lifetime of the power source. This technique makes the nodes to operate in energy rich state for longer duration, thus increasing the performance of the network. In addition usage of Super Capacitors reduces the number of batteries used. These e-wastes obtained from the energy sources are a big threat to the Mother Nature, flora and fauna. This paper proposes a technique to overcome these issues by employing a Super Capacitor thus producing a load balanced energy rich resultant bunch of nodes.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection based on Ensemble Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Credit card is considered as one of the most popular paying methods for online and regular purchases, due to the advancement in communication and electronic commerce systems. Thus, the fraud associated with these transactions increased significantly. The great utilization of electronic payment is highly affected by this fraudulent transactions, which requires urgent detection to solve this issue. Therefore, effective and efficient approaches to detect fraud in credit card transactions are needed. To catch the fraudulent transaction, a good fitting model is needed, hence researchers recommends the use of various Machine Learning (ML) techniques, because of its beneficial characteristics. The main aim of the research work is to implement an ensemble based ML techniques for Credit Card Fraud Detection (CCFD). The strength of our model is a combination of the forces of the three subsystems; Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE), CCFD's using ensemble classifiers, and Synthetic Minority Oversampling (S MOTE) to deal with the problem of unbalanced data to identify the most effective prediction features. The proposed model run typical tests on two real databases of public credit card transactions, including fraudulent and official ones. Based on the comparison of other ML methods, the extra tree classifier has performed better and achieved high efficiencies such as 96% of accuracy and 57.95% of F1-measure.

articleTitle: Plan of Block-chain Enabled Confirmed Key Management Protocol for Internet of Medical Things Development
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the emergence and influence of the Internet on the healthcare industry, it necessitates the need to preserve, access, and update medical records from anywhere and at any time. Medical discrepancies associated with Electronic Health Records (EHR) must be addressed, as it has privacy and security issues. The lack of consistency was certainly the most critical issue, but it is far from the only issue with EHR. Decentralized cloud models based on blockchain platforms have previously been proposed and deployed to address interoperability and privacy concerns. Other issues, though, remain. Three of the most critical concerns are scalability, usability, and accessibility. This research study presents a Secure eHealth Framework (SeFra) based on a progressive temporal blockchain method to overcome the aforementioned concerns. Context-based Merkle Tree (CBMT) and Context-Based Access Control (CBAC) are two of SeFra's core building blocks that are specifically focused on establishing security, increased integrity checking, and access control approaches. Interoperability and scalability issues are also handled through the use of temporal characteristics in conjunction with HL7 protocols, as well as data management using the Interplanetary File System (IPFS). The results show that temporal shadow concepts and context-based features have an impact on the proposed framework's capacity to safely manage the Personalised Micro Ledger (PML). It also aids in the collection of medical data in text format with temporal aspects and its dissemination to all other peers in line with the restrictions set in the context-based smart contract.

articleTitle: Recipes for Radical Innovation: A Configurational Analysis based on TOE Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Based on the technology-organization-environment (TOE) framework, this study adopts the fuzzy set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA) approach to elucidate the configurational path of radical innovation. This study found four configurations of radical innovation, which are the "resource-input", "R&D collaboration", "competition-driven", and "multiple interactions". The research results contribute to the configuration effect of technological, organizational, and environmental factors on radical innovation and further provide practical enlightenment for managers to utilize these three levels of factors to achieve enterprises’ high-level scientific and technological innovation.

articleTitle: Impact of Internet of Things (IoT) in Healthcare: Challenges and Application
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Software engineering and electronic designing have been converted into quite possibly the most eminent innovative outcome, the Internet of Things (IoT). The term Internet of Things refers to the organisation of physical items that are outfitted with sensors, equipment, programming, and other advances to interface and exchange data with other gadgets and frameworks over the internet. The effect of IoT in medical care has been altogether expanded over the most recent couple of years. IoT is assuming a significant part in the medical care area to expand dependability, precision and usefulness. With the populace increment, medical problems are additionally rising and the need for mechanical arrangement is requested. This is the place where IoT assumes a major part and IOT overhauling present-day medical services with promising innovative, efficient and friendly perspectives. Web of Things execution into the medical services area, specifically, information asset the executives, security, loss of protection, access control, and partner coordinated effort. IoT will be a vital piece of the patient's finding, treatment, recuperation, and observing interaction sooner rather than later. It is apparent that an enormous number of articles will be associated with the IoT network. This paper audits the most recent IoT applications in the health care space and most recent advancements. This paper likewise features the exploration holes in the IoT. The goals of this audit paper to help analysts in growing further developed and productive IoT based applications to help medical care.

articleTitle: Mining Algorithm for Eliminating Redundant Data in WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the Internet of Things, wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are being utilised in a number of ways, and their development is constantly developing. These data are often transformed in numerous formats, enormous quantities and safeguarded information. For modern applications in industry, home, Smart Cities and Transportation, the quality of the information obtained from the sensor data is vital. With all these limitations available, the enhanced mining algorithm needs to be identified so as to increase the quality of services supplied by the IoT based on the WSN. This article highlights the technological problems that need to be taken into account for constructing IoT-based wireless sensor networks to improve the quality of the application on this platform.

articleTitle: Implementation of Embedded Real-Time Operating System and Application Software based on Smart Chip
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this paper, the design of embedded real-time operating system based on computer network technology and smart chip is proposed. In the hardware design, design the micro-kernel architecture, keep the basic services in the system kernel, move other functions out of the user space, design the Ethernet controller, the embedded and tailorable TCP/IP protocol iwip in uc selenium s— The transplantation process on lI. Finally, it focuses on the characteristics of μCOS-II and the transplantation process, and studies the software development methods and processes of the NIOSII soft core and embedded real-time operating system μCOS-II.

articleTitle: System and Method for Early Detection and Post Disease Detection of Dementia Patients
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Talking about dementia, in basic simple words dementia can also be known as madness. Dementia is a chronic disorder of once mental ability caused by an injury or any brain disease, it can cause some serious issues such as personality changes, memory issues, communication problems and much more. The most common type of dementia diagnosis among older adults is Alzheimer’s disease which is caused by changes in brain, others are Vascular Dementia (VD), Lewy Body Dementia (LBD) and Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD). For dementia, we currently have one and only psychological treatment recommended by National Health and Care Excellence (NICE) i.e. Cognitive stimulation therapy, hence we need to make sure that we have a proper dementia prediction model. To overcome or to achieve the particular thing, we need to take help of the existing techniques present in the market. Hence, the aim is to use support vector machine and random forest to prove which works better and to get a novel accuracy.

articleTitle: Learning Robotic Skills through Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The application of modern robots has increased dramatically in recent years making systems more productive and efficient. Some of the traditional control approaches used for teaching movement to robots are PID (Proportional Integral Derivative) and LQR (Linear Quadratic Regulator) feedback controllers. These controllers have proven to help keep a system in a stable condition. However, as the model dynamics become more complex and sensitive, these techniques become more difficult to implement. Thus, traditional control techniques for adaptive robotic locomotion with multiple degrees of freedom render the task of maintaining a stable state impossible. This paper addresses the problem of traditional control approaches and proposes reinforcement learning for handling complex states as RL (Reinforcement Learning) is a robust framework and can tackle these problems by testing sample states in a simulated environment and will optimize the robot in each state to achieve for the maximum reward. To train the proposed robot in a realistic environment, this study applies the exploration and exploitation approach, as well as algorithms like curriculum learning, shape reward, input and reward normalization, etc. The findings of this study will generate novel ideas for locomotive robotic motion control and will encourage the use of artificial intelligence in robotic and other automated machines.

articleTitle: SIW based Self-diplexing Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this paper, novel design of self diplexing antenna based on SIW technology to operate at ISM/WLAN bands is proposed. The proposed antenna has a smaller rectangular cavity nested inside the larger hexagonal shaped cavity. By inserting nested cavity, a good isolation was achieved at proposed frequencies of 4.9 GHz and 5.8 GHz. Four different shaped slots are inserted and a performance comparison is made to choose the best out of them for the proposed cavity configuration. The higher frequencies are realized by exciting the cavity mode (TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">110</inf>) and placing the different slots shapes in the outer cavity. Resonating frequencies controlled by varying position of slot away from feed line. The diplexing antenna with rectangular slots shows a high isolation greater than 48 dB between the ports. The designed model shows gain values better than 3 dB at the proposed frequencies.

articleTitle: Investigation on Impact of GaAs and GaN Blazed Grating for High Performance UV-VIS Spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this paper we considered a periodic structure with a blazed profile and compared the behaviour of light interaction with III-V semiconductor materials, GaAs and GaN. Th efrequency domain interface of electromagnetic wave is employed to represent wave propagation in a single grating cell. In order to simulate the both faces of the cell, the floquet periodicity constraints are employed on a periodic basis. This article indicates the recent advances in the use of the novel materials namely GaAs and GaN in blazed gratings, with their refractive index properties. Plots were made of the grating’s transmittance and reflectance for every material as a function of the incident angle. Also, we evaluated the performance of these gratings at different thickness ranging from 200nm to 800nm and at different blaze angle range. It was found that, gratings with GaAs with blaze angle 17.1° have a good potential to use it in the range of 200nm to 800nm in reflective type grating and GaN with blaze angle 23.96° is a good material for transmission type grating in the range of 200nm to 800nm.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of CSRR and SRR Structure Incorporated Multiband Slotted Antenna
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this paper a comparison of two significant categories in the metamaterial transmission line resonating structures, Split ring resonator (SRR) and Complementary split ring resonator (CSRR) is presented. Including slots in a rectangular patch antenna resulted in multiband frequency operation. A multiband antenna resonating in the frequency 1.66GHz, 2.34GHz, 2.82GHz, 3.3GHz is incorporated with SRR and CSRR structure. Both metamaterial unit cell structures are implemented, and results are obtained. The metamaterial resulted in the improvement of results like gain, directivity, bandwidth, also radiation pattern of the antenna. Comparison of CSRR and SRR results on multiband antenna will be analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a T-gated AlGaN/GaN HEMT with Added Mini Field Plate
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The impacts of a HEMT with a 60 nm T-gated mini field plate device are examined in this study research work, along with the DC/RF properties of the device. The implementation of T- Gate field plate along with the Graded barrier layer configuration in the device provides an extreme impact in the drain current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ds</inf>) of the device. A graded channel AlGaN/GaN HEMTs with the implementation of mini field plate (MFP) exhibits with I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ds</inf> =1.6 A/mm. In the proposed de vice the InAlGaN layer is simulated which enhances breakdown voltage of 96% while maintaining RF performances of the simulated device. The simulated device exhibits breakdown and fT of 98V and 185GHz respectively.

articleTitle: The Design of Online Cluster Framework for Infectious Disease Nursing Courses in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Infectious disease nursing curriculum ideological and political is to combine the infectious disease nursing curriculum with the content of ideological and moral education, and organically combine the two in the practice of ideological and political education. The fundamental is morality, and the core is to cultivate people. The reform of ideological and political teaching of infectious disease nursing courses follows the characteristics of nursing humanistic care education, and explores new models of moral education for nursing students. Explore the ideological and political design of infectious disease nursing courses from the three aspects of teaching objectives, teaching content and teaching methods to achieve the purpose of establishing morality.

articleTitle: Hybrid Energy Control for an Electric Vehicle Using Super Capacitor and Battery
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research focuses on the power flow controlling strategy of a battery/super-capacitor hybrid energy based storage in electric vehicles. When acceleration is abruptly increased, the peak power demand rises, and the battery life decreases. A super capacitor-based additional energy storage device is used to overcome this constraint. The suggested ARDUINO-based system is designed to detect high power consumption, cruise and regular acceleration modes, and switch between battery and super-capacitor storage as needed to extend battery life. The proposed electric vehicle regulating approach has the advantage of effectively tracking a predetermined speed profile. As a result, the battery size is adjusted, and the power efficiency of the hybrid energy storage system is improved. Finally, the MATLAB/Simulink platform confirms the efficacy of the simulated outcome.

articleTitle: Fire Fighting Robotic Vehicle using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: It is a well-known fact that, fire can spread quickly in the presence of flammable materials. There is a significant risk of the destruction of entities and lives. Furthermore, there is a chance that the firefighters, who are exposed to fire will get permanent injuries. Hence, to reduce the impact of fire on firefighters, this research study has developed a fire fighting vehicle, which will automatically extinguish a fire in the event of any firer-elated accident. When the flame sensors detect a fire, a signal will be sent to Arduino. The water pump will be operated by the Arduino's built-in program to pump water. As a result, the proposed design will extinguish a fire without any human intervention.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on Covid-19 Vaccine
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic continues to have an influence on the global population's health and well-being. In this pandemic situation, vaccination plays an major role in everyone life. The pandemic has transformed our perspective of the world to a new level. COVID-19 is spreading rapidly, and the only way to stop it is to vaccinate the whole people. Using Machine Learning (ML), this paper assesses people's opinions regarding COVID - 19 vaccine among college students. The COVID-19 vaccination was examined using social network analysis. For the greatest findings and accuracy, sentiment analysis can be done using the Naive Bayes Algorithm, Support Vector Machine, and Logistic Regression. The datasets can be collected as actual statistics.

articleTitle: Load Fault Diagnosis in Induction Motor using Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Industries require early diagnosis of induction motor faults to avoid complete failure. The use of machine learning and condition monitoring to detect faults has huge promise. Machine learning can be used to detect motor faults. To avoid losses, induction motor faults must be rectified promptly. Fault detection using machine learning algorithms is an excellent method for preventive maintenance. If any fault arises, the motor may continue to process and produce failure in windings core etc. Hence, the faults can be prevented by the monitoring the motor output values and cutoff the power before the motor gets damaged. This research develops a machine learning strategy based on algorithms in order to learn the characteristics from vibration signal’s frequency distribution. This is mainly to characterize the operational status of induction motors. The operational status includes the parameters such as temperature, voltage and current. It automates and intelligently diagnoses faults by combining feature extraction and categorization.

articleTitle: Data Augmentation Model for Audio Signal Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)

authors.preferredName: J Eswar Naga Sai Kumar Babu

abstract: In analysis of data, data augmentation pertains to ways to raise the availability of data yappending slightly tweaked copies of current data or creating new generated information from the collected data. Data augmentation can assist improve the performance and output of machine learning models by producing new and varied cases to train datasets. Data augmentation techniques, which produce deviations that the model could meet in the real world, might make machine learning models more robust. This research study suggest the use of such audio data augmentation to solve the challenges of data scarcity, and further the impact of various part of this approach is also investigated. The suggested model generates cutting-edge findings for system environmental sound prediction. With the aid of the function, we can also use the 4 kinds of data augmentation to improve the data and show the outcome in an effective manner. Data augmentation is well known for combating over fitting and improving the generalization capabilities of both the input and output systems. The proposed system's recognition performance has improved as a result of the experiments done with four augmentation techniques those are Random Sequential, Random Independent, Specified Sequential, Specified Independent.

articleTitle: Wearable Belt Antenna for Human Body Communications AT 2.45 GHz
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research work has designed a wearable belt antenna for performing human body communications at 2.45 GHz. The proposed antenna mainly focuses on developing a wireless body communication application. The proposed antenna can be designed with a probe feed by leveraging -26 DB return loss and producing omni directional radiation pattern. This antenna exhibits good VSWR, better impedance matching and satisfied gain. The designed antenna is simple and compact. Moreover, it can be implemented in a wide variety of applications.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Ways of Constructing Computer Network Security in Colleges: Considering Complex Worm Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This article analyzes the current situation of computer network security in colleges and universities, future development trends, and the relationship between software vulnerabilities and worm outbreaks. After analyzing a server model with buffer overflow vulnerabilities, a worm implementation model based on remote buffer overflow technology is proposed. Complex networks are the medium of worm propagation. By analyzing common complex network evolution models (rule network models, ER random graph model, WS small world network model, BA scale-free network model) and network node characteristics such as extraction degree distribution, single source shortest distance, network cluster coefficient, richness coefficient, and close center coefficient.

articleTitle: Food Items Prediction Using Sentimental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In today’s scenario, feedback, opinions and reviews provided on the web, social media etc., has proven to be an indirect promotion for the products, companies etc., which acts as an x-factor for increasing the sales of those items or gaining the popularity of the particular domains. This research work has proposed an autonomous feedback system to the food items available at the Chandigarh University using sentimental analysis, that will help the customer to judge the items as a good or bad based on the opinion score of the items. Here, a database has been created by using an initial survey on the previous customers for the food courts located at the University. For comparative analysis, five machine learning algorithms viz., Naıve Bayes, Naıve Bayes using TF-IDF techniques, Multi-nomialNB, XG Boost, and Cat Boost were selected. Naıve Bayes was selected as a baseline for the comparative sentimental analysis of the food items using the CUFC corpus. Experimental analysis shows the highest accuracy (80.40%) using the Cat-Boost algorithm, thus providing the improvement of 18.80% over the baseline feature. Further, this study will also help the customers to select the food items based on the opinions scores and will be also provided to the shopkeepers for improving the items as per feedback received. Thus, imparting and integrating a latest technology for food-oriented applications.

articleTitle: Four Port DC-DC Buck Boost Converter for Hybrid Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Sustainable economic growth necessitates the smart and deliberate application of renewable energy sources. In Polish circumstances, combining many renewable sources of energy in a single design is a new difficulty. Renewable energy sources, despite their benefits, are characterised by seasonality and extreme unpredictability. The hybrid power systems want to be stepped up, because renewable energy supplies fluctuate daily and seasonally, efforts to promote the benefits of self-contained. The goal of this study is to create an energy mix-based self-sufficient power supply system. This type of system is self-contained and offers stable power from renewable sources to small-scale residential consumers. The power is made up of modules with a modular architecture that allows different power configurations and renewable energy sources to be mixed together.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality and 4D Imaging Technology in the Wisdom of Interactive Guidance of Acupuncture and Massage
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this article, in order to study the application of virtual reality and 4D imaging technology in the intelligent interactive guidance of acupuncture and massage, the control group used the traditional teaching mode to teach, the VR teaching group used the VR technology teaching mode to teach, both groups taught 6 class hours, immersed Sense, interactivity, imagination, and multi-perception. The application characteristics of VR technology in acupuncture and massage teaching are: to create a brand-new teaching model, break the limitations of time and space, and reduce the risk of clinical operations. The pass rate of the in-class test in the VR teaching group was higher than that in the control group, and the difference was statistically significant (P <0.05). There was no statistically significant difference in the theoretical assessment scores between the two groups (P> 0.05).

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of SRAM cell using FinFET
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: As CMOS devices near the nanometer regime, scaling them down has a number of repercussions, such as short channel effects and process fluctuations, which degrade the device's reliability and performance. FinFET is one of the promising ones for overcoming this problem, according to researchers, because it has better channel management and lower overall capacitance, the 6T Static Random Access Memory (SRAM) circuit design will perform better. This research study evaluates 6T and 9T SRAM cells created with CMOS and FinFET by utilizing 22nm technology and further these SRAM cells are compared based on numerous performance characteristics such as write delay, read delay, static power and static noise margin (SNM). The Predictive Technology Models (PTM) files are used to simulate the 22nm CMOS and FinFET based SRAM cells which are developed by Arizona State University in the Cadence Virtuoso tool.

articleTitle: A Study on Optimization of Dual Rail and Charge Sharing based Dynamic Latched Comparator
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: There has always been a demand for high speed and low power analog to digital converters (ADCs). This demand has pushed to increase modification and enhancement in conventional parent architectures especially for low power consumption and fast comparison. A meticulous study on improvisation of conventional dynamic latched comparator through two topology changes namely dual rail with enhanced nodal voltage difference and charge sharing technique is done. The tradeoff between power and delay during incorporation of charge sharing technique is also discussed. The proposed dual rail architecture has power consumption of 2.639µW and a delay of 48.07ps. Incorporating charge sharing technique, power consumption of 907pW and delay of 230.2ns is observed.

articleTitle: Rain Streaks Detection and Removal from an Image using Canny Edge Detection and Combination of Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Raindrops that cling to a window’s glass can drastically limit a scene’s visibility and degrade the perceived image quality. The ability to detect and remove rain drops will assist many computer image applications. Detection techniques such as L0 gradient, k-means clustering, RGB separation, and removal techniques such as median filter were employed in the preceding methodology. This work describes a new Rain drop identification and removal technique based on YCBCR, canny edge detection, novel filtering that combines median and Gaussian filters.

articleTitle: A Wearable Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulator
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) is a condition that results in the formation of blood clots in deep veins of the lower leg or thigh in the human body and it becomes severe in the later stages making the patient fatal. The treatment for preventing severe DVT is provided as a means of therapy by giving a neuromuscular electrical stimulation at the site of DVT. Most of the available neuromuscular stimulation devices are not wearable, non-flexible, and non-user-friendly and they are not affordable to all people because of their high cost. Some of the available wearable neuromuscular stimulators are of disposable type (disposable after a few hours), and so it costs so much high for the user who needs to buy regularly for continuous therapy. Hence, a low-cost non-disposable type wearable neuromuscular electrical stimulator is proposed. In this work, a neuromuscular electrical stimulator is designed and tested using the Proteus simulation software. Pulse generator to generate required stimulation pulses of varying pulse widths between 10 µs and 1000µs with the pulse repetition rate of 1 Hz and a constant current regulator to deliver a constant current of 5 mA are the two most important blocks of the neuromuscular electrical stimulator design. The obtained results have met the requirements paving the way for future research work to develop a prototype.

articleTitle: Computer Vision based Student Behavioral Tracking and Analysis using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Over the past couple years, The Covid-19 virus has triggered a global pandemic, requiring us all to remain isolated in our homes. Students and professionals were forced to move to the virtual world to resume their academic activities. This has led people to use video conferencing applications on a massive scale. However, it has been a challenge to monitor many students at the same time by a single invigilator/faculty thereby, the student engagement and interaction has dropped in a rapid scale. To overcome this challenge, an open-sourced modular system is proposed to Face identification for face spoofing using CNN and students’ gaze tracking with head positioning & eye tracking in real-time virtual video conferencing applications using computer-vision & deep-learning. With a single-Shot-Multibox detector, using ResNet-10 Architecture as the foundation, the student’s face is recognized and detected. Then to take facial landmarks, pre-trained Histogram Oriented Gradients (HOG) and linear SVM object detectors are used. With the captured features, the eyes are detected using dlib and the centers of eyeballs are extracted using OpenCV eye classifiers. This paves the way to perform eye tracking and gaze tracking. All the stated Machine learning modules’ output are aggregated and translated to a graphical representation as the final analysis of the students’ behavior in the virtual sessions.

articleTitle: Dimensionality Reduction based Medical Data Classification using Hybrid Linear Discriminant Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence and its applications are evolving in all domains especially in the field of medical science. Voluminous amount of clinical data is available and most of the data remains unused. If it is used in effective way then it will be useful in diagnosing the human lives in earlier stages. An effective classification system will help the medical practitioners to provide appropriate diagnosis in earlier stage. Usually, medical data will have lot of features and if all the features are included in decision making it may lead to over fitting of the classification model and in turn accuracy will be affected. Also, if all the features are included in decision making then it will take more resource in building the classification model. Hence there is a need for an effective dimensionality reduction method which not only reduces the number of structures but also improves the classification accuracy. This article recommends a novel ensemble technique named Hybrid Linear Discriminant Analysis (HLDA) for reducing the dimensionality of the medical data. And Random Forest classifier algorithm has been used for building the classification system. For proving the effectiveness of the proposed method, it is compared with LDA, PLS, PCA dimensionality reduction algorithms. Three UCI benchmark datasets namely Breast cancer Wisconsin dataset, Cervical cancer dataset & Heart failure clinical records dataset have been used for the evaluation of the work. The new result proves that this proposed method outclasses the other methods in accuracy, specificity, and sensitivity.

articleTitle: AI-SMLA: An Artificial Intelligence based Smart Machine Learning Algorithm for Complex Image Segmentation Issues in Vertex Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Today’s machine learning is considered as one of the artificial intelligence technologies used in many ways. Its functions are very accurate, from receiving the given input data to calculating, measuring and outputting it. It is used to calculate a valid result without user intervention. In that order the applications of this machine learning method in digital image processing technology are constantly increasing. This technology is used for everything from overcoming facial identities to calculating the various photo identities of mobile devices currently in use. In this paper a smart machine learning based algorithm has been designed to effectively handle vertex image processing environment and complex image segmentation functions. Its special feature is that it examines the given photos based on its dead pixels and calculates the correct results. There will be no human intervention in this system. The proposed smart algorithm was compared with some existing algorithms.

articleTitle: LQG Approach based Speed Control of Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Induction motors are A. C. motors also termed as an asynchronous motors converting electrical energy to mechanical energy. These motors are presently in wide use in plenty of domestic and industrial applications. The speed control of these motors has always been an aspect of great importance. In this paper, the transfer function model pertaining to a single phase induction motor is identified using MATLAB. Then for its speed control, automatic control systems based on SIMC and LQG approaches are developed and analyzed using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Quick Aid: Mobile Application for Product Rental
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This research study aims to design and develop Quick Aid app with an innovative idea of renting products in order to help people by supplying the essential/non-essential things. The primary objective is to create a product rental app, which enables the user to rent a product or require a service, so that the product/service can be used by the requestor. This system could also help in building a strong relationship among people and solve the problem of people not owning non-essential things readily. It is always difficult to find a product for rental or short term. Quick Aid app will make it easier to get products and services by utilizing the help of other users. Quick aid delivers simple yet innovative way to request items or services by using a simple online form from the user. The placed online request is then notified to every other user of the app, so that the interested people could help in fulfilling the request.

articleTitle: Design of Apnea Detector for Health Care System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Sleep apnea (SA) as Obstructive rest apnea (OSA) is becoming the most widely recognized respiratory confusion amid rest, which is portrayed by ends of wind current to the lungs. These discontinuances in breathing must last over 10 seconds to be viewed as an apnea occasion. Apnea occasions may happen 5 to multiple times an hour and may occur up to four hundred times each night in those with extreme SA. During sleep apnea the muscles of the upper respiratory airway collapse. And is known as cessation of breathing. An exceptionally easy-to-understand gadget which could be utilized both by a medicinal staff in an emergency clinic or by the client at home since it doesn't require any talented preparing. This work has developed an ultra-negligible exertion microcontroller-based breath checking system. It has a test which involves a straightforward temperature sensor and that must be put at the tip of the nasal area. The test can be cut with the nostril. The breath rate is appeared on a 16x2 LCD screen. If the breath rate is past customary, a flag gets actuated. The structure will make an alert if the breath rate isn't predictable or if there is an unforeseen unpredictable change. The readings obtained from simulation and real-time will provide a base to the doctors for studying the patient and understanding the type of apnea by understanding the difference in temperature and breath rate obtained by the device. The simulation acts as a correction reference for the real time device. The portability and low-cost make the device easy to use and flexible amongst all genre of patients. By attaching GSM module to the device, the patient's conditions can be monitored from anywhere in the home or in the hospital. Doctors receive the message based on the program given to the chip and choose to respond to message accordingly. The device provides an appropriate measure of the breath rate of the patient to whom it is attached to and acts as a monitoring device for the doctors and provides them feasibility and flexibility in understanding the condition and responding accordingly to the message received in accordance with sensors attached and the way the patient's breathing pattern change.

articleTitle: Intelligent Research on Ubiquitous Cloud Networking Technology and Media Network in the Construction of Sports Training Optimization System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Intelligent research on the ubiquitous cloud networking technology and media network in the construction of sports training optimization system is studied in the paper. By simulating the playback behavior of users, the actual URL, partition size, definition, actual playback page address and sharing address of all video segments can be obtained. At the same time, it can support the collection of valuable content attributes, such as the name, channel and number of episodes of video or audio. All kinds of information resources in the field of network operator management need to be reasonably refined and sorted, so as to greatly improve the field ability of network operators and promote the all-round development of their comprehensive ability. Hence, the designed model is considered to the sports training optimization system. Through the experimental simulation, the performance is validated.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Temperature Controlled Intelligent Portable Reefer Container for Delivery Optimisation in Logistics and Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The statistics reflect the fact that a considerable quantity of perishable goods is wasted due to poorly designed supply chain management systems. This throws up the challenge in improvising or innovating a novel modus operandi in every stage of supply chain management. This article discusses a novel way of providing micro-management of goods by designing an intelligent temperature-controlled portable reefer container which can be transported effortlessly. The reefer container consists of a Peltier plate arrangement integrated with an automatic temperature control system (ATC) used to regulate the temperature precisely inside the container. The Global Positioning System (GPS) fitted on the container delivers precise location coordinates to the stakeholders in real-time. The multipurpose reefer container holds the feature of a seamless remote temperature setpoint change based on the type of perishable items loaded into the container. The supply chain management manager can remotely adjust the settings using Over The Air updates (OTA). The reefer container is equipped with an access control system to offer accurate delivery of products to the customer with the help of a quick response system with a credible user interface.

articleTitle: Online Dance Guidance Intelligent System based on Online Video Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper proposes a dance training system based on motion capture and virtual reality technology. Inspired by the traditional learning model, this system imitates the actions of the teacher, and students can imitate the actions demonstrated by the virtual teacher projected on the screen. The system captures students’ movements, analyzes the movements, and feeds the results back to the students. The dance teaching form based on motion capture technology is an interdisciplinary field of computer science, education science, and teaching psychology. It draws on new ideas in other fields. Theory, new technology and new methods to resolve the shortcomings of the traditional teaching model.

articleTitle: Game Analysis System of Landscape Garden Plant Configuration Optimization based on Multi-View Image Comprehensive Evaluation Index Matrix Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of loss of detail information and inconsistency of regional brightness in the results of the block-based multi-view image comprehensive evaluation index matrix algorithm, the pixels are firstly clustered according to the pixel intensity of the multi-exposure image group. In landscape garden design, landscaping and plant landscaping occupy the core position, the diversity and adaptability of plant configuration and planning have gradually become the main indicators to measure the construction quality and artistic charm of landscape gardens. The plant configuration, planning principles and specific methods of landscape architecture design are analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Linux System Development for Online Training Courses for Vehicle Engineering Majors in the Environment of New Four Modernizations and Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Guided by the training needs of Internet of Things engineering talents, starting from the three aspects of cultivating the knowledge ability, professional ability and professional quality of students majoring in Internet of Things engineering, in order to meet the needs of talent training and actively promote the construction of "new engineering", this paper focuses on electrification. The contents and plans for improving the curriculum system are discussed in three aspects: intelligent network connection and sharing, so that students majoring in vehicles have the knowledge system and comprehensive literacy of the "new four modernizations". Plan the teaching content of the Linux system development course, and explore the corresponding teaching methods. Build an effective teaching quality monitoring system and form an efficient internal teaching supervision mode in the teaching and research room, and conduct full supervision, evaluation, feedback and improvement of the teaching links of each professional course.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing based Math Word Problem Solver and Synoptic Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Math word problem solution generation is a process where the machine itself will automatically generate/provide a final answer as well as a step-wise solution for the provided Math word Problem. This simply measures the machine's capacity and capability to comprehend and reason in natural language. This paper proposes a solution where various techniques are implemented, different models are tried and tested, and the scope is extended to cover multiple types of Math Word Problems. The domains worked on are speed, distance, time, profit and loss. The main purpose of this paper is to create a system with various domains in a hybrid framework which can accurately produce a step-wise solution for the given Math Word Problem. Based on the different tested approaches, Random Forest (used for Domain Classification) + 2 custom Transformer Model (used for Equation and Formula Generation) are found to be the most suitable method which provided the best accuracy.

articleTitle: Prediction and Classification of Alzheimer’s Disease using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The goal of this study is to predict the different stages of Alzheimer’s using deep learning which is a cutting edge machine learning technique. Alzheimer is a neurodegenerative disease that affects many people especially elders. Hence the early detection of Alzheimer helps in controlling the disease. In the recent years, the diagnosis of Alzheimer has become one of the challenging problems in medical field. Deep learning is an efficient technique to predict it in its early stages. The MRI scan images is taken as the input dataset. The Convolutional neural network was used for preprocessing and training the given dataset. The system's main purpose is to detect Dementia in different patients based on various categories. The technique was developed using Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) data from Kaggle and Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS). The OASIS dataset has a dimension of 300 rows x 15 columns of patients’ data on different stages of Alzheimer’s. Various performance criteria, such as accuracy, precision, Recall and F1 score, are evaluated for the OASIS Dataset. Different classifiers are used to discover the appropriate parameters for each model, including Logistic Regression, KNN, Decision Tree, Neural Network, Random Forests, and Gradient Boosting to predict the different stages of Alzheimer disease.

articleTitle: Application of the Video Recognition Algorithm of Prosperous Tang Culture in the Multi-Frame Intelligent Generation Framework of the Zeitgeist Fragments of Chant Chang'an Poems
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: By analyzing the images of Chang'an used in the poetry of the prosperous Tang Dynasty, this paper briefly summarizes the specific meanings of these images of Chang'an in the poems, so as to draw the important influence and positive significance of the images of Chang'an in Li Bai's poetry creation. In the teaching of ideology and morality, some succinct, beautiful, recited and educational verses are used for teaching, which can not only stimulate students' interest in learning, but also enlighten their thinking. The similarity measurement method is used to smooth the surface level of graphics rendering, and the fusion method of object level and surface level follow-up information is used for animation image rendering, so as to realize the three-dimensional reconstruction and dynamic generation of multi-frame two-dimensional animation images.

articleTitle: CMOS Memristor Hybrid Circuit based High Speed Low Power Multiplier Design
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Memristor circuits are known to be less power consuming, extremely fast and highly scalable. Memristor, a two terminal fundamental passive element having a unique pinched hysteresis loop, can act as a memory element. This paper introduces design of basic logic gates using CMOS and memristor for the design of a 2 bit multiplier circuit. The performance of all circuits had analyzed against standard CMOS implementations. Promising results were obtained by the transient analysis done at 1.0 Volts. The results infer that hybrid design can be used as a suitable replacement for CMOS circuits in the future cases due to its great speed and high scalability.

articleTitle: Application of Various Sensors in Rehabilitation Program and Clinical Practices
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The electrical apparatus that conveys signals from one energy part to another is known as a sensor. Sensors have already been classified in many ways by various authors and agencies. In the beginning division, the sensors are distributed into active and passive categories. The further that follows is based on the phenomena of reformation, or the input and output. Thermoelectric, Photoelectric, Electrochemical, and other common conversion processes are a few examples. The ultimate sorts of sensors are analogue and virtual sensors. The subsequent may be a list numerous styles of sensors that are usually utilized in various applications of these sensors are used for measure one among the physical properties like Temperature, Resistance, Capacitance, Conduction and so on. Accelerometer, Infrared Sensor, Pressure Sensor, Light Sensor, Ultrasonic Sensor, Smoke, Gas, and Alcohol sensor, Touch Sensor, Colour Sensor, Position Sensor, Hall Effect Detector, Sound Sensor, Tilt Sensor, Strain and Weight Sensor, Temperature Sensor are a few illustrations.

articleTitle: Research on the Development and Intelligent Informationization of Language Testing and Evaluation System Based on SSH
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the development process of language evaluation system based on SSH. The system adopts B/S mode, uses SSH as the framework, uses Java language and mysql database, and also uses some classic design patterns and JSP, servlet, css, etc. in the development process. Popular technology, all programs that can generate executable files are evaluated using dynamic evaluation technology in software testing. Programs that have errors in the compilation process and cannot generate executable files are transferred to the code repair module for repair, and then repaired again. Compile and process, if executable files can be generated and transferred to the dynamic evaluation module for evaluation, the data is safe and reliable.

articleTitle: Concurrent Testing of School Student Information Management System based on Multi-Terminal Information Upload Optimization Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper designs and implements multimedia information query based on mobile terminal, and realizes real-time or non-real-time sending and receiving display of video and image information. At the same time, the multi-objective optimization model that minimizes the investment cost is optimized and solved by using the simulated annealing algorithm. The overall development process of college student information management system. Firstly, it briefly introduces the research background, significance and research status of the system, and then introduces the system ASP.NET related concurrent development technology and database development tools. On this basis, the system needs to be analyzed and obtained.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Medical Diagnosis Platform based on Intelligent Evaluation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Design and implementation of intelligent medical diagnosis platform based on intelligent evaluation algorithm is presented in the paper. When conducting remote consultation, medical data mainly comes from the clinical information systems of various hospitals. The key to effectively integrating medical data in various hospitals is to solve the information integration of electronic medical records. The standardization and structuring of medical record information determines the application scope and level of electronic medical records. Adaptive computing can be combined with wireless sensor network technology, so that medical staff can obtain simplified, accurate and reliable medical information and reduce the difference between medical service levels. With these theoretical information, the designed model is then integrated wit the medical imaging analysis. Through the testing, the performance is validated.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Flipped Classroom Technology and HCI Interactive Mode in English Online Course Design from Smart Data Mining Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In order to make students more flexible and active, the mobile Internet has spawned a "flipped classroom" teaching mode and human-computer interaction mode that subverts the traditional teaching mode. This article will start with the connotation of flipped classroom and data mining technology, and explore its application methods. In the current SPOC flipped classroom teaching mode, the data mining of learning progress is carried out, combined with a certain human-computer interaction, starting from the theoretical basis, teaching objectives, implementation conditions, operating procedures, and teaching evaluation, which is a relatively complete and systematic teaching mode. The flipped classroom teaching mode based on SPOC is designed.

articleTitle: Tag Analysis of Multimedia Training in Sports Classroom Combined with Computer Complex Decentralized Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper studies the tag analysis of multimedia training in sports classroom combined with computer complex decentralized platform. The network entity has two pairs of keys: one is the public-private key pair contained in the certificate, which is recorded as the certificate key; the other is the key pair used for issuing the certificate, which is recorded as the issuing key. The scheme contains two types of certificate transactions: one is a transaction signed by the network entity with its own issuance key pair for issuing certificates periodically; the other is a transaction for initializing and resetting the issuance key pair. Hence, with the consideration of the mentioned algorithms, the designed multimedia training in sports classroom combined with computer complex decentralized platform is further implemented. Through the comparison testing, the performance is then shown.

articleTitle: An ACL Injury Prediction Device for Athletes using Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Mesh
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) connects the tibia and femur and acts as a stabilizer. Any misplacement or damage leads to mobility losses. Hence this device prevents ACL injury by measuring the flexibility of ACL through a "flex sensor" and also measures the acceleration, heartbeat rate, oxygen content of the blood, and ECG. This work helps in the reduction of cost spend for surgery and also helps the trainer to coach the players or athletes based on the output produced by the device and ensure the fitness of the athletes. The result proves that it is a suitable applicant used work and it is inferred from the comparative analysis.

articleTitle: Construction of College Sports Online Guidance System based on Real-Time Network Flipped Classroom Information Flow Graph Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current situation of the current college physical education teaching mode, and focuses on the construction of the MOOC-based college physical education "flipped classroom" teaching mode, which mainly includes the preparation of pre-class learning resources, the independent learning of students, and the systematic teaching of knowledge by teachers in class. In order to fully guarantee the security of the computer in the actual application process, avoid the risk of computer network information security leakage, and comprehensively improve the efficiency of social development, a network security proxy server can also be established than the traditional physical education teaching design process.

articleTitle: Advanced Women Security System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: According to WHO and NCRB social authorities’ business company, 35 percent of women all over the world are experiencing weird fitness suffering in public places such as railway-bus terminals, foot routes, and so on. Acts of violence and assault against women have escalated in recent years. As the number of female employees in industries and other areas of the commercial market grows, women will be required to work longer hours and travel to far and isolated locations. However, in recent years, the exponential increase in assaults and violence against women has posed a threat to women's growth and development. This painting depicts a potentially formidable female protective mechanism. This paper presents a prototype tool that ensures women's safety. The suggested device is a flexible and interoperable combination of a tool and alertness that can be used to adorn and empower people. When an abnormality is identified, a cutting-edge location is acquired with the help of a GPS sensor, and an alarm message is sent to the nearest police station for immediate rescue of the victim.

articleTitle: Informatization Data Collection for University Tourism Management Specialty based on Computer Simulation 3D Scenic Spot Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The application of 3D virtual imaging technology in the imaging of scenic spots can shorten the distance between players and the game plot, and increase the thrill of victory for the game characters in the duel. This paper discusses the design and implementation skills of 3D virtual imaging technology in games from the aspects of interface, scene design and interaction design. The tourism management major has also gradually carried out the reform of the talent training mode and curriculum system under the background of modernization, so as to adapt to the needs of the society for tourism talents in the context of the rapidly changing informatization. The binocular vision system based on ChemOSII can effectively realize = dimension matching, and the improved census transform local matching algorithm can be realized quickly and conveniently.

articleTitle: Design of Postharvest Physiology and Processing System of Fruits and Vegetables based on Intelligent Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Based on the intelligent communication technology, this paper analyzes the fruits and vegetables postharvest physiology research results in the past 50 years, and comprehensively introduces the postharvest research progress of fruits and vegetables from the perspectives of the physiological, biochemical and molecular biology of the enzymes related to cell wall and ethylene metabolism during the postharvest maturation of fruits and vegetables. This article reviews the light technology commonly used in fruit and vegetable preservation and its application in maintaining the quality of fruits and vegetables and controlling diseases. Postharvest physiology of fruits and vegetables such as respiration, ethylene synthesis, tissue browning, active oxygen metabolism and antioxidant capacity, flavor and other aspects.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Reconfigurable Antenna forMultiband Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A miniaturised reconfigurable antenna filled with slots for multiband applications was designed in this paper. The suggested antenna design makes use of a rectangular patch, a microstrip patch and a partial ground plane. To increase bandwidth, U-shaped slots are inserted in the patch and the ground planes. The 60mm x 0.7mm (L x W) radiating element was mounted on a FR-4 epoxy dielectric substrate with a relative permittivity of 4.4.
