The patches on the ground plane are the different from the patches on the antennas, which are identical. Each antenna is capable of operating at (3.1GHz–10.6GHz), which is the maximum frequency and its corresponding sub bands. In this work, the antenna generates two switchable patterns. The PIN diodes were installed in the ground plane's horizontal slots (s). The antennas were designed using HFSS. The suggested antennas have a return loss more than -10dB over through the specified operating bandwidth, according to modeling results.

articleTitle: Safe Production Mode of Tunnel Construction Under Complex Address Conditions based on Ant Colony Algorithm and Night Vision Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper designs the basic architecture of the tunnel construction safety risk control system based on the ant colony algorithm, and designs an ant colony optimization algorithm embedded with local search technology, and guides the ants to perform a global search through the indicators in the heuristic information synthesis change, using lasers and polarization The integration of multiple technologies such as light, optical filtering and modulation has successfully developed a high-performance active infrared polarized laser night vision imaging system with strong anti-interference ability and image clarity. It has also evolved from a safety management system based on vulnerability evaluation. Research on the specific content of this framework in terms of classification, identification, sharing and transformation of risk management and control information, and informatization of tunnel construction safety risk management and control based on modern information technology.

articleTitle: Welding Machine Automation for Pneumatic Vessel Fabrication
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Fabrication process in industries requires highly skilled workforce to get caliber in part finishing. Welding process joins two materials at their melting point temperatures using thermal energy to melt and allowing them to cool results in fusion of materials. A quality welding demands high accuracy in the welding posture and hand speed of the skilled person. During mass production, manual welding results in loss in quality and production rate. An automatic welding Robot for compressor tank fabrication is developed with PLC as the controller, this design gives higher accuracy in the welding process in the compressor tank fabrication. A compressor tank is made from a sheet metal that is cut and rolled to desired diameter and then the edges are welded to prevent them from separating. The quality of welding in this case needs to be high because there must be no holes and pores in the welded area which may cause air leakage in the life cycle. The automation system gives a workable solution to the existing system and a dynamic analysis of stress and strain profiles of the impact that the welding machine supported by a cantilever beam is done. Programmable logic controller takes control of the transverse velocity with which the wielding head is moving and the optimal values for the welding process. Automation of the welding process is done with SPM(Special purpose machine) combined with automation tools viz. PLC, servo motors, servo drive, human machine interface, sensors & pneumatics systems.

articleTitle: Automatic Traffic Clearance for Emergency Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In the face of fast-growing world, the people’s need and demand have changed drastically. Not everyone is dependent on the public transport because of the increase in the travel time and low comfort. People need a vehicle for themselves and their family for an easy commute and comfort. This has led to a boom in the productivity and sales of the automobile industry. The production of automobile has touched 80 to 90 million vehicles per year giving rise to massive amount of 800 million(approx.) vehicle production in the last decade. The traffic density in every part of the world has gone up due to the increase in the automobile production. Traffic congestion is still a major problem to handle especially when it comes to emergency vehicles.An Automatic Traffic Light Control System for Emergency vehicles can come in handy to aid in the swift movement of emergency vehicles through traffic at junctions. The proposed solution uses a NodeMCU micro-controller which has ESP8266 embedded in it and uses Wi-Fi as a communication medium. The vehicle when in range of a signal will be given the control over the signal. The person operating the specific vehicle must input his direction of travel. Based on the direction given, the signal will be changed to clear the traffic in the emergency vehicle’s lane.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligent Framework of High-frequency Data Algorithms Assisting College Students' Legal Awareness Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this paper, the CAViaR model based on high-frequency data modeling is extended to high frequency, and a mixed-frequency data sampling MV-CAViaR model combining high-frequency and low-frequency data is constructed. This paper puts forward several ways and methods to strengthen the cultivation of college students' legal awareness, including: creating a good social environment that the whole society pays attention to; strengthening and improving the legal education in schools and enhancing the subjective initiative of college students, so as to promote quality education in colleges and universities and the process of improving the legal quality of citizens, promote the creation of a good social environment under the rule of law, and accelerate the construction of a socialist harmonious society.

articleTitle: Autonomous Multiple Robots Exploration using Evolutionary Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Multiple robots exploration is an emerging research area in Robotics. Autonomous robotic exploration in natural or manmade disaster areas speeds up the search and rescue operations and it saves the life of victims and human rescuers. It helps to explore the places such as space, ocean, and forest etc., where humans are unable to physically visit. The important challenge existing in this autonomous multi-robots exploration problem is collaboration between the robots team to accomplish the entire mission. This research paper proposes an autonomous exploration strategy by means of a swarm intelligence algorithm. The entire area to be explored is partitioned into a number of smaller regions. Exploration of the entire smaller regions collectively brings the robots team to accomplish the overall mission. Hence the efficient allocation of robots to the smaller regions to be explored consumes optimal resources like battery energy and task completion time. The Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm is applied for allocating the smaller regions to the robots in an efficient manner. The simulation of the proposed environment partitioning and exploration strategy is implemented in the Robot Operating System Gazebo simulation tool. A flat and smooth terrain environment of known boundary conditions is considered in the simulation study. The environment contains a number of obstacles at random positions. The task allocation time, overall robots battery energy consumption is minimal by the proposed exploration strategy. The real time implementation of the proposed concept is the future scope of this research.

articleTitle: Logistics Efficiency Optimization of Cross-Border e-Commerce based on Remote Sensing Network Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Logistics efficiency optimization of cross-border e-commerce based on the remote sensing network optimization algorithm is studied in the paper. The popularization of 5G mobile communication technology in my country has become an inevitable trend. With the further development of my country's network information technology, it is not a long time to popularize 5G mobile communication technology nationwide. Hence, the theoretical background is selected in this paper. The output can be viewed through the console or store it through the logging system. Write the converted data into the receiving queue of the logistics tracking system DB, and the database background processing code will complete the specific processing of the message, generate the relevant result data, and store it in the corresponding data table according to the rules. Parsed real-time data. Then the integration of the remote sensing algorithms are studied and the system is implemented.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Tagging Algorithm Coupling University Legal Intelligence Perception Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Based on the artificial intelligence tagging algorithm, user scenario theory and qualitative research theory, this paper discusses the elements of intelligent data services for think tanks, and attempts to establish an accurate and usable network public opinion evaluation system to monitor the heat of emergencies. The theoretical foundation of the legal service platform is to integrate the theories of grassroots social governance, the modernization of the rule of law, the concept of "Internet +", and the business management system of judicial and administrative organs into the construction system of the public legal service platform. evaluation mechanism.

articleTitle: IoT based AGV System for Medicare
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the improvements in Robotic technology, medical settings are embracing more parts of automation to enhance the services in hospitals. Robotic systems in health care have sparked attention because of their potential usage during the COVID-19 pandemic. Because of the high prevalence of COVID-19 transmission, healthcare personnel is exposed to increased dangers, pressure, and workload to satisfy the needs of patients for drug delivery, temperature checks, oxygen level checks, and food distribution. To avoid this, an AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) based Medicare system was developed to prevent health care employees from coming into touch with patients. An automated guided vehicle or AGV system act like a bot that follows the marked long lines from one position to the desired position. The bot follows the track from the nurse’s station to the patient. The proposed system is equipped with a Pulse-oximeter and a contactless temperature sensor. The Pulse-oximeter records the patient’s oxygen level and pulse rate, while the contactless temperature sensor records the patient’s temperature. These bits of information are communicated to the doctor through the mail using IOT technology, and the data is then posted to a webpage where it may be retrieved for future use. The AGV system is equipped with a tab that allows for video chatting with the doctor. For the convenience of patients, this tab spins 360 degrees. This allows doctors and nurses to stay away from COVID-affected patients. With the use of the tray coupled to the system, this bot will also help in transporting prescribed medications and meals from the nursing station to the beds. This system in the future can be implemented in all the hospitals so that the safety of frontline employees is ensured.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics of Crime Data using Supervised and Ensemble Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Predictive analytics involves using data and machine learning techniques to determine the probability of future outcomes based on large amounts of data. Criminal acts are a part of society in every way, whether as an offender or a victim, it is inevitable that every individual has seen a criminal act. The predictive analytics approach has been used to analyze the crime data. It is achieved using a data set containing crime records. Many events of crimes are present in the crime data set. Based on the location of the crimes,the trends of crime have been analysed, based on where it happened the most, and time(week)over the years.The prediction of crimes based on time, location, and other parameters has been performed using supervised machine earning techniques including K-Nearest Neighbour, Random forest and ensemble methods.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic Propagation Network Topology Algorithm of Chinese Film Culture Based on the Darknet Cloud Video Sharing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper studies the communication strategy of film and television culture based on the new media context from three perspectives: communication based on audience needs, communication in various media forms, and communication with own brand advantages. Feature analysis, a darknet traffic identification algorithm is designed to identify darknet traffic in encrypted cloud video sharing. The experimental results on a large number of benchmark problems show that the proposed algorithm can effectively maintain the balance of the proportion of excellent particles and non-optimal particles. It maintains the diversity of the population and avoids the premature convergence phenomenon of the classical particle swarm optimization algorithm on high-dimensional and multimodal problems.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection of IoT Communication Equipment Based on Entropy Ideal Point Method: from the Perspective of Quantum Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this paper, the entropy weight method is used to calculate the weight of each evaluation index, and a soft foundation treatment plan decision model based on the ideal point method based on the entropy weight is established. An anomaly data detection method based on the ideal point method based on entropy weight is proposed. In the process of classifying massive anomalous data, multiple constraints that can constrain the abnormal characteristics of tags are introduced, and the dimensionality reduction and restriction processing of IoT communication data is performed to avoid expansion. The search process is optimized, and the support vector machine is used to complete the detection and classification in the restricted area. Experimental results show that using this algorithm can search for massive amounts of IoT communication anomaly data in an automatic learning process, and improve the accuracy of anomaly data detection.

articleTitle: Multi SRR Patch Antenna with Split Ring Configuration Feeding under 8 GHz Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The demand for wireless devices is increasing every day and hence the compact antenna. A microstrip based patch radiator is possibly the most compact forms of available antenna utilized in modern communication system such as mobile handset because of its obvious reason viz. easy on chip development, low cost and low profile. It is a well-known fact that the electrical length of a patch antenna is responsible to its compactness rather its physical length. Various approaches have been investigated by numerous researchers mostly in current period, however the majority of them suffer from deprived return loss and limited bandwidth. The overall dimensions of a patch antenna can be reduced by reducing the electrical length by using metamaterial concept such as Split Ring Resonator (SRR) structure. This research study has designed four SRR based antennas for the most utilized spectrum under 8 GHz frequency range. At 1.9 GHz, the proposed, modified SRR structure can radiate with a bandwidth expansion of 30% over the third design, and at 7.40 GHz, a bandwidth enhancement of 68.2 percent has been achieved over the first design. The results of the fourth suggested antenna are the best in terms of antenna gain at the maximum frequency range of 7.40 GHz, with 1.82 dB, a 2.79 dB improvement over the first design. In terms of circular polarization, the first design can produce circular polarization at a frequency of 6.9 GHz with an axial ratio of 2.1 dB and a bandwidth of 220 MHz, while the third design has the lowest return loss at -42.65 dB at 5.7 GHz but weak antenna gain and axial ratio. The suggested design, which uses various SRR and feeding methods, gives us a sense of taste of SRR's impact on antenna gain, bandwidth, and axial ratio for multiband applications in the 8 GHz band.

articleTitle: Multi-view block Fusion Algorithm for Data Mining and Intelligent Sports Training
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Multi-view block fusion algorithm for data mining and intelligent sports training is designed and implemented in this manuscript. It has excellent performance in the field of ultra-high-speed real-time image processing. The dual-DSP high-speed real-time signal processing system of this system consists of two DSP chips as the core to form a neighborhood image parallel processor, and realizes synchronous parallel operation processing through the division and decomposition of system tasks. With the designed model, the ideas on the block fusion algorithm for data mining and intelligent sports training is then discussed. Under the condition of the same fill factor, the composite aperture array structure can obtain the higher resolution and imaging quality than the typical aperture array structure after image restoration, which is an effective means to obtain very high resolution. This will be further considered to optimize the sport system. The performance is validated by performing a general testing on different datasets.

articleTitle: Moisture based Irrigation System using Node MCU and REES52 Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This particular irrigation practices an efficient way on monitoring the amount of water applied to the fields. It has a response monitoring system and a soil moisture sensor which is present here. This is used in agricultural related projects where the sensors have probes made up of nickel, and also it is very robust. This system responses in a way to measure the moisture which is present in particular soil with comparison in values/desired values provided by the user. It generates a notification if the water level of the soil goes below/above the values. It also helps in the problems which are related in agriculture where irrigation is done at irregular interval. Here, Irrigation System based on IoT along with ESP8266 NodeMCU Module is proposed. Initially, it identifies the moisture content and sends the data to application particularly data can be measured using gauge systems. Which shows us the moisture level and the type of soil? It indicates whether the motor has to be turned OFF or ON. The moisture is also monitored by Mobile Application Dashboard which displays the level of moisture content in soil. The project runs mobile application to display moisture content in soil which is to acquire the same. This content of moisture in soil is acquired by an application dashboard through connected Wi-Fi.

articleTitle: Dance Movement Simulation based on Virtual Reality Technology: from Body Recognition to Movement Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In order to verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the combination of motion capture technology and teaching, based on dance teaching, this paper proposes a dance posture analysis method based on virtual reality and feature vector matching, and proposes a motion capture technology based on the complexity of learning dance. The dance teaching method uses motion capture technology to decompose a whole complex dance movement into many small segments, and make teaching animations, instruct students to learn and imitate according to the short dance moves, so that abstract theories become vivid, intuitive and easy to understand. Conducive to the innovation of education and teaching methods.

articleTitle: Design of KVM Switch using USB Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: A KVM switch (KVM is the abbreviation for keyboard, video (monitor and mouse) allows a user to control several computers from a single device. It is generally known that the normal switches cannot be connected with laptops and computers, as the KVM switches are originally made for connecting with laptops and computers. It is difficult to connect one or more devices with laptops and computers with the help of the KVM switches. Recent advancement in KVM switch technology is the integration of Universal Serial Bus (USB) items. USB gives PCs true plug-and-play capabilities. USB-ready PCs can be connected to any external de vice without including an inside card or setting up the gear manually. When you plug in a USB-viable gadget, it is recognized by the USB PC. The proposed scaled-down system will plan a USB Hub KVM Switch. This USB innovation permits the KVM change to introduce the console and mouse's supported presence to every appended PC. This gives an extraordinary advantage – every appended PC, PC, Macs, and Suns, can be booted up all the while. It can also be used as a captive to control USB PCs in numerous stage setups. This permits clients to merge control of both inheritance and USB-empowered PCs in a single design.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of MEMS Bimaterial Cantilever using Piezoelectric Layer for Solar Energy Conversion
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In this paper, COMSOL Multiphysics software is used to develop and evaluate a small-scale MEMS bimaterial cantilever solar cell with a piezoelectric layer, which is used to generate electricity. The process of converting solar energy to electrical energy has been accomplished by the use of MEMS solar cells, which are capable of transferring heat to voltage with temperature change and direct piezoelectric action, respectively. For starters, a bimaterial cantilever (made of aluminium and silicon dioxide) is deflected by absorbing solar energy, resulting in the conversion of solar energy to mechanical energy. A piezoelectric layer of aluminium nitride is then used to convert the mechanical vibrations created into electrical energy, which is used to power the device. This structure, when compared to conventional solar cells, is capable of absorbing the entire solar radiation spectrum, the electrical voltage produced is alternating current with a 2V amplitude, thereby eliminating the need for inverters, and the size of our MEMS solar cell (200 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) is smaller than that of previous research.

articleTitle: OTP Camouflaging using LSB Steganography and Public Key Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: One Time Password (OTP) provides an additional layer of authentication to a web server, protecting against fraudulent attempts so that the information is protected between the user and the recipient. In the field of Steganography, various techniques are employed to conceal data in the media in such a manner that human perception cannot identify it. As the proposed algorithm is a combination of both Cryptography and Steganography it meets all the challenges very efficiently. Initially, the data is ciphered with a novel algorithm of asymmetric key cryptography and then the ciphered message is camouflaged in the cover media using the Least Significant Bit (LSB) steganography technique. Even if the intruder cracks the LSB algorithm used here, he will get the encrypted data since the source data is not present on the cover media. To obtain the original data, the ciphered data must be deciphered with the deciphering algorithm. With the additional security, it is impossible to crack the original data from the cover media

articleTitle: Big-Data in Healthcare Management and Analysis: A Review Article
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Big data in healthcare is used to describe a massive amount of information about the collection of patient records created by digital technology. It also helps in managing hospital performance. The main aim and objective of this article are to show how big data is used in healthcare and management with the analysis of big data. Mainly this article narrates the special characteristics and different phases of big data as it is an essential process because it allows health care providers to go down and learn more about the care they have provided to their patients. In a health care section, big data analytics offers many benefits for detecting severe disorders in the starting phase and delivering higher quality healthcare facilities to the correct client at the proper time to improve the quality of life of the patient. If data is managed and analyzed correctly, it will provide a piece of meaningful information for the patients. It is also beneficial, reducing medical errors, preventing mass disease, detecting diseases, and focusing on patients’ personalized care. As this big data in healthcare has a characteristic too based on that, they are defining themselves. Big data analytics in healthcare allow for analyzing large amounts of information from more than a thousand patients.

articleTitle: Design of Sports Psychological Intelligence Test Environment based on Multi-Dimensional Sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Design of the sports psychological intelligence test environment based on multi-dimensional sensor fusion is studied in the paper. Due to the diversity of samples, effective data fusion based on samples has become an important issue to be studied in product reliability assessment. At present, the research on data fusion methods at home and abroad is very mature, and hence, the multi-dimensional sensor fusion algorithm is integrated to finalize the designed algorithm. Accordingly, for the efficient analysis, the testing is the core section. Cloud testing is a new testing scheme based on cloud computing technology. It provides software testing or automated software testing tools to users as a service. With these combinations, the model is then applied to the sports psychological intelligence test environment. Through the testing, the platform is proven to be efficient.

articleTitle: Secure Cryptosystem for Preventing CCA Attack
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The use of intermediary re-encryption cryptosystem rescrambles the message each time the client time sends it. It expands the calculation time and makes ready for sending invalid re-scrambled figure message to the client that builds the opportunities for CCA (Chosen Ciphertext Attacks). In the wake of refreshing the public key with administrator, the beneficiary public key is utilized to send the mystery key for start to finish encryption. It makes use of an effective intermediary re-encryption (PRE) plot in the ICN structure to help reduce the overhead on the client side while maintaining adaptive information distribution among supporters and, surprisingly, their cooperators. It creates an entrance control strategy for registered clients, assigns a group of supporters to this arrangement who can access the substance, then scrambles the substance thing using a Shamir’s Secret polynomial mystery consistent and the switch’s portion, i.e., creates an encoded empowering block, and sends the empowering square to the capacity switch.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Art Guidance System based on Intelligent Robot-Assisted Painting Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper combines user portrait recognition technology, scene recognition technology and voice interaction technology to realize student attendance, classroom teaching interaction, and voice interaction on the Android platform. Connect the Raspberry Pi and Arduino with a camera. After the camera recognizes the image, it draws the corresponding pattern on the whiteboard. Through our equipment, a more natural and scientific human-computer interaction teaching mode is realized, the D-H modeling method is used to establish the mathematical model of the painting robot, and the robot kinematics is analyzed and verified using the Robotics Toolbox toolbox based on the MATLAB platform.

articleTitle: Computer Evaluation System Design of Enterprise Financial Risk Evaluation Index System under the Background of Parallel Data Era
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the parallel era and changes in the social environment, enterprises are under increasing pressure to survive. Business operations should establish correct risk prevention awareness, improve risk prediction and prevention capabilities, and achieve sustainable development of the enterprise. Especially under the impact of big data, major changes have taken place in the internal and external environment of business operations. It is necessary to reshape the traditional financial risk evaluation index system to accurately predict and avoid risks in the development of enterprises with a scientific system. Work, discuss how to build a financial risk evaluation index system, in order to accurately predict the development trend of the enterprise, so as to make the correct production and operation or investment and financing decisions, so as to ensure the longevity of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Simulation and investigation of dual axis MEMS scanning mirror for LiDAR applications
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The MEMS design has a lot of potential for future advancements. Size and cost minimization are the primary goals of MEMS. It is used in biomedical imaging, microscopy, and LiDAR for unmanned vehicles employing mirrors and suitable actuator systems. This research work presence a low-voltage powered scanning mirror for LiDAR applications, particularly for UAVs (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles), and gesture recognition. A leverage structure with appropriate materials such as PZT (Lead zirconate titanate) ceramics is used to create a scanning mirror with a good FOV (Field Of View) and low power consumption. In a MEMS-based mirror, proper acting mechanisms are used to provide a high FOV and two-axis scanning. To model the performance of proposed system, the COMSOL Multiphysics software is used to run finite element simulations. The mirror may be observed by moving up to 180 µm in either direction along the z- or y- axis. For an input voltage of only 5 V, the aforementioned displacement is obtained.

articleTitle: Cross Layer Design for Primary User Modeling in Cognitive Radio Ad-hoc Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Presence of Primary Users is one of the critical roadblocks for successful operation among SU network. Increasing primary users’ activity in the available spectrum band, enhances the chances of interference and spectrum unavailability for Secondary Users (SU) communication. All the existing techniques consider the fact that, at a time, only single Primary User (PU) is using the license spectrum band. But this assumption is not correct for real-time scenarios, as there can be multiple PUs operating simultaneously, further degrading the SU performance. Hence, all the interference calculation, channel switching and spectrum access design related models considering single PU operation, do not make practical sense for real time deployment of cognitive radio sensor network. Therefore, the concept of multiple PU operation (CogRPU) has been proposed by considering the real time field deployment scenario. Furthermore, a suitable cross layer design is developed in order to overcome the CogRPU problem and it showed a considerable performance improvement between without cross layer and with cross layer techniques.

articleTitle: Application of Internet-based Continuing Nursing in the Intelligent Surveillance System of Patients with Parkinson's Disease after Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Explore the effect of Internet-based continuation of nursing care on patients with Parkinson's disease (PD) after surgery. Instruct patients to install APP, use the 5 functions of APP to provide continuous care for patients in hospital and out of hospital, and ensure the application compliance of patients with APP. The anxiety level, quality of life, medication compliance and frequency of follow-up visits were compared between the two groups of patients 3 months after discharge. Achieved a rapid response to the needs of home care; through the understanding of disease knowledge, self-monitoring of health conditions and targeted care plans, the urgent needs of patients for professional care have been met

articleTitle: Improved Honey Encryption to Protect the Internet users from Various Attacks
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In recent months, there has been a rise in security issues as well as data breaches, which has led to increased anxiety regarding the safety of online banking. The existing authentication method for internet banking, which is entirely dependent on a password, is not robust enough to withstand the recent wave of successful password guessing and cracking attacks due to the fact that it is solely dependent on a password. As a potential remedy to this problem, the authors of this paper proposed a method known as Honey Encryption (HE), which adds another layer of protection on top of the user authentication measures that are already in place. When a malicious user guesses the password for a cloud account, the HE algorithm immediately generates false bank data that is impossible to distinguish and then directs the attacker to an account that has a fake password. This prevents the attack from being able to determine whether or not the password that was guessed is valid. As a direct consequence of this, cracking attacks and guessing passwords have become increasingly challenging. In addition to that, this research investigates different attack models and potential defences for password-based authentication schemes.

articleTitle: Quantitative Measurement Method of Tourism Contribution to Regional Economic Development based on Reinforcement Learning: from the Perspective of SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Based on the reinforcement learning and SVM, this paper studies the quantitative measurement method of tourism’s contribution to regional development. It regards tourism as a "detached" economic activity in the current industrial sectors and closely related to it. Based on tourism economics, applied statistics, and investment output Analysis and other theories and methods give a quantitative measurement method of the contribution of tourism to regional economic development. Firstly, it quantitatively analyzes the spillover effect of the regional tourism economic growth from the overall perspective, and then specifically combines the characteristics of the tourism industry to explore the tourism economy.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Desktop Image Compressed Sensing Framework based on FCM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This article first introduces the kernel-based FCM algorithm (KFCM), which has a good clustering effect on data sets with ambiguity and uncertainty; the image compression sensing algorithm has a strong global optimization ability, but it is easy to fall into the local area. Optimal. For this reason, with the help of quantum theory, the particles are "quantized", the movement of the particles is updated through the quantum revolving gate, and the quantum NOT gate is used to increase the diversity of the population; and compared with the FCM, FCMS, FCMS1 and FLICM algorithms. Evaluate algorithms and experimental results according to relevant evaluation criteria.

articleTitle: Identifying and Predicting Covid-19 Using Hybrid Model for CT Images
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Coronavirus is a virus that spreads swiftly sickness that pollutes people's minds, yet there are creatures in like way spoiled thinking about this tainting. The bit by bit People's lives, their thriving, and a country's economy are impacted owing to this dangerous famous disease. In this research work major confront for accurate recognition of COVID-19 infected patients and then dividing them to avoid the society scattering. Proposed hybrid model is trained Conventional neural network (CNN) and Support vector machine (SVM) it helps for exact prediction, hence making a fair and realistic assessment. The predefined DNN classifier and the proposed Hybrid model classifiers are trained and evaluated the model for identifying the better activation functions. The effect of different activation functions on the Premade DNN classifier and proposed CNN Classifiers are compared and analyzed based on the accuracy and average loss obtained. The result and discussion of the proposed model is achieve above 98% outcome across all the performance metrics from the CT images within seconds with high precision which can be a faster option comparing to the usual reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RTPCR) technique.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Canonical Signed Digit Adder-subtractor Circuit
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Addition and subtraction are two fundamental arithmetic operations performed by modern digital systems such as microprocessors and microcontrollers. A generic hardware design is available for adding two numbers the problem of carry propagation persists. To overcome this issue several attempts were made such as Carry-look ahead adder, Carry save adder, Carry select adder, etc. Previous attempts to optimize the computational complexities are based on a binary number system. This paper prescribes a 4-bit adder circuit for the addition of two numbers in Canonical Signed Digit (CSD) format to optimize the delay and area of adder circuits. The proposed circuit finds its applications in a variety of high-speed ALUs (Arithmetic and logical unit) and digital filters.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Vedic Multiplier and Modified Vedic Multiplier in Direct Digital Synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In most digital applications, the usage of multipliers impacts the speed of operation as well as utilizes maximum space. The evaluation of high-speed multipliers that adapt the reconfigurable structure of repeatable blocks is required to reduce the space. The proposed Vedic Multiplier Vedic Synthesizer (VMVS) system implements low latency techniques in Direct Digital Synthesizer (DDS) coupled to the output of the Vedic multiplier. The component is initiated once and called up at every iteration on demand. The DDS is the unique word-controlled Digital Phase-locked loop that enables stable clock output at every locking condition. The achievement of the proposed design is that latency is reduced by 14% and power by 0.001w. The crafted structure produces synthesizable VMVS to produce the adaptable output and stable clock.

articleTitle: The Problems and Countermeasures of Educational Information Management in Colleges under the Background of Smart Campus Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Educational informatization in colleges and universities has become one of the main issues in the reform of education work. At the stage when the country is promoting the development of educational informatization, the construction of informatization in colleges and universities has received extensive attention. The focus of the construction of educational informatization in colleges and universities is to optimize and reform education and teaching by means of informatization technology, so as to cultivate innovative, applied and comprehensive talents that are more in line with the needs of current social development. This article analyzes the concepts, problems, and corresponding strategies of college education informatization to ensure the effective development of college education informatization.

articleTitle: Prediction of Heat Transfer in Smart Buildings using Internet of Things based Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With rapid growth and a higher standard of living, the demand for usable energy has increased tremendously over the last few decades, with the construction industry being one of the most notable examples. The energy efficiency of a building is influenced by a variety of factors, including the weather in the area, the structure characteristics, and how people use electricity. These algorithms can be used to generate a prediction model for smart building indoor temperature forecasting using the Internet of Things and several commonly used artificial intelligence algorithms, which can then be used to generate a prediction model for smart building outdoor temperature forecasting. It was necessary to employ freely accessible software tools in order to make geometric and sensory data available in a virtual reality application and to build the PMV and PPD indices. On a low-cost edge computing device, semi-automatic analysis of streaming thermal images from a non-intrusive sensor was performed in order to offer near real-time Mean Radiant Temperature (MRT)estimations. An experimental space that had been mechanically preconditioned was filled with a dynamic temperature environment, and a prototype of the system was employed in a series of trials. Results show that the data backs up the fact that the system output and the heat sensations felt under different settings are consistent.

articleTitle: Self-Organization Modeling and Data Tracking Algorithm of Overall Functional Data of Party Organizations in Secondary Colleges of "Internet" Electronic Information Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Self-organization modeling and the data tracking algorithm of overall functional data of the party organizations in secondary colleges of "Internet" electronic information platform is studied in the paper. The designed algorithm first converts the high-dimensional and sparse feature representation into low-dimensional dense vectors and random distributed sets through the embedding layer factor vector. The diversity of basic recommendation results is an off-line index of the general recommendation system. There is a temporary lack of the deep learning to optimize the diversity of recommendation results. This method is mainly used to establish research models of complex systems under strong adversarial situations. In general, the concept of "liveness" is mainly based on the ability to maintain a stable system information function in a complex system and the detection-based multi-target tracking can be divided into online tracking and also offline tracking. The system is implemented considering the mentioned issues, and is verified through the systematic verification.

articleTitle: Network Optimization Algorithm for Enterprise Financial Management Decision-Making based on Multi-Agent Network Node Information Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for identifying important nodes in complex networks based on the aggregation of multi-attribute preference information. Firstly, according to the local characteristics, global characteristics and spatial location of nodes, five attribute indicators, namely degree centrality, betweenness centrality, compactness, structural hole and K-kernel (Ks), are selected to construct an identification model of important nodes in multi-attribute complex networks. Propose a research on the construction scheme of enterprise financial management informatization based on cloud computing. Then expound the strategy for enterprises to choose the "cloud finance" construction scheme, and then summarize from demand analysis, planning and design, deployment and implementation, operation and maintenance management and optimization and improvement Five steps to build the basic process of "cloud finance".

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Information Model for Modern and Contemporary Transformation of Chinese Literature based on Big Semantic Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the development of global economic integration, all countries in the world have set off a wave of "cultural research", and my country, as a cultural power, naturally research work is the top priority. The development of the concept of "cultural studies" has brought a certain impact on the cultures of all countries in the world, which is both an opportunity and a challenge for the development of modern and contemporary literature in my country. The new changes in the style include the renewal of stylistic concepts, the creation of various styles (styles, systems) of new literature, and the refresh of the style of new literature, all of which can be demonstrated in the practice of style change by Vietnamese new literature writers.

articleTitle: Automated Database Management System using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Face recognition from an image or video is a promising biometrics research topic. Video surveillance cameras are popular in public places, and they provide important safety benefits. Since the entity does not require any assistance, the face recognition in a surveillance system has become a critical research topic. It is well-known all over the world. Face recognition outperforms other biometric recognition techniques in terms of uniqueness and validity. The human face recognition is a challenging topic in the computer vision due to its diverse and dynamic nature. Precision and recognition speed are considered as the critical challenges in this industry. The primary objective of the proposed work is to examine various face detection and identification methodologies in order to deliver a comprehensive solution for facial recognition and detection, which is more effective and has a great response in an image-based way. This gives a solution based on facial rich dataset research by incorporating imagery, attitudes, ethnicity, and colour.

articleTitle: HCB: A Hybrid CatBoost Enabled Chronic Kidney Disease Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) acts as one of the commonly occurring problem that causes death globally. The increasing scale of CKD patients created the need for finding the early prediction systems and solutions. Due to large dataset and recorded information of patients, the processing time is high and scaling the dataset in the initial stage is highlighted. The presented study is focused on the foremost problem of kidney disease prediction in the early stages using a robust machine learning algorithm. The proposed work is modeled with Hybrid CatBoost algorithm in which the iterative learning process enables the system to adjust the weight of the training pattern; hence an effective prediction is made. The system is used to make the initial correlation factor between the training vector and testing vector of the CKD patient’s data. Higher the learning rate, better the prediction accuracy. The proposed system is validated through a number of quantitative measures such as accuracy, precision, recall and F1Score.

articleTitle: Design of Multiband Antenna Loaded with Slot using SIW Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The substrate-integrated waveguide is an emerging competitor for realizing microwave and millimeter-wave ranges. This article illustrates a novel design of a multiband antenna loaded with a slot by using a Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) technique of 21x 27 mm dimensions for performing multiband operation. For the antenna's radiation, a pair of rectangular complementary split-ring resonators are used in the proposed design. These slots apply to exciting tight space hybrid modes present in SIW for significantly improving the antenna performance. The proposed antenna is implemented by using a printed circuit board (PCB) technology. A pair of complementary rectangular beam splitting slits are used in the proposed work to improve the antenna performance. As a result, the proposed antenna operates at 2.61 GHz, 2.82GHz, 4.465GHz, 5.76GHz, and 6.6GHz, covering S-Band and C-Band applications. Proper radiation characteristics have been confirmed by the HFSS electromagnetic tool.

articleTitle: IoT based Monitoring and Controlling of Environmental Parameter for Implementing Intelligent Irrigation System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The Solar Powered Drip Irrigation Method was designed to reduce agricultural water consumption. The proposed module utilizes a microcontroller and several sensors such as soil moisture sensors put in root system belts, temperature sensors, and ultrasonic sensors positioned at the tank's roof. The water volume in the tank is maintained using the on and off operation of the pump. Then the moisture content and temperature are regulated by opening and closing of the solenoid valve. A Wi-Fi module is connected to the control unit that processes sensor data, initiates actuators, and broadcasts data over the internet, allowing the user to watch the farm in real-time from whatever distant area. The programmed code was designed depending on the soil moisture, humidity, and temperature values and is programmed into the central controller to regulate the amount of water delivered to the area for irrigation and the pump to fill the water in the tank. Renewable solar power the entire system. The sensing unit, actuating unit, and the central control unit are wired together, and the control unit communicates with the app through a wireless link. The primary goal of the research is to reduce the farmer's manual intervention, which saves money and resources.

articleTitle: Sports Competition Data Collection and Intelligent Training System based on Ultra-High-Speed Cameras

abstract: A new practical intelligent controller based on ARM+FPGA architecture for high-speed real-time data acquisition application is researched, designed and implemented. This paper expounds the realization of hardware system technologies such as the main processor ARM minimum system, the coprocessor FPGA minimum system, and the communication interface between ARM and FPGA. After optimization and improvement, a new sports training motion video analysis system is proposed. Through detailed analysis of the overall design and detailed design of the system, the system performance test is further carried out. Based on ultra-high-speed cameras and data rapid capture and analysis of sports data game feature extraction.

articleTitle: Internet Dynamic Communication Network Modeling of Qiang Flute Culture Research from the perspective of Music Anthropology based on Loop Signal Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Qiangdi has deeply influenced Qiang culture, cultural and historical research. She has strong characteristics in the playing skills, rhythm, timbre etc. Play gives people an ethereal, lingering melodious melody, People can taste the Qiangdi flute in the body that the immortality of the soul with the old voice. Internet dynamic communication network modeling of Qiang flute culture research from the perspective of music anthropology based on loop signal detection is discussed in this paper. Using this design, the low accuracy of the single-pixel context-based design can be overcome. The obtained context variables are used to construct a loop detection model, and fusion rules are designed based on the detailed judgment of the high-frequency coefficients, so as to obtain fusion with rich details and clear edges. In order to meet the needs of cyberspace language life, communicative symbols must have sufficient self-sufficiency and adaptability. To achieve this, the dynamic communication network modeling is conducted. Through the application testing on the Qiang flute culture research from the perspective of music anthropology, the performance is tested to be efficient.

articleTitle: Multi-fusion Analysis of College Education Information System based on High Robust QoS Optimization Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The paper analyzes the multi-fusion analysis of the robby of university education information system based on multi-characteristic information fusion optimization, analyzes the policies of OOS routing in IP networks and QoS multicast routes: from I QoS definition and mechanism Research on the integrated service model (INTSERV), resource reservation agreement (RSVP), differential business model (Diffserv), analyzes the integration of Internet information technology and higher education, put forward the information and technical literacy of college teachers, and continuously improve information colleges and universities management to make full use of information technology innovation teaching methods to further improve the quality of teaching quality and teaching level.

articleTitle: Automatic Pollution Detection and Monitoring of Coal Mining and Quarrying Industry using NodeMCU
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Mining is the process of extracting minerals and raw materials from the underground which is used for petroleum production and other materials needed for our day-to-day life. Quarrying is the extraction of minerals directly from the surface which is used as like the mining process. Mostly probably the mining and quarrying industry are being main source for minerals and its by-products. In our country, the common facts that all known is that the pollution is high in coal mining and quarrying industries. In the proposed system, the execution parameters such as temperature, humidity, fire, pH, gas and harmful acids are monitored. In this project the pollution causing agents are monitored and their levels sensors are continuously monitored through mobile phones. From the monitored output the following concentration of the each and every harmful substances present in the coal mining and quarrying industry. After continuous monitoring, alarm is set in the field, where if any accidents are going to be happened.

articleTitle: Fusion model of Modified Wavelet Transform and Neural Network for medical image compression
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Medical imaging is one of emerging fields that has high impact on analysis and diagnosis of diseases. Image compression is introduced in the medical image processing to solve memory and bandwidth requirement problems. In this paper, a hybrid image compression method by integrating Modified Wavelet Transform (MWT) and Neural Network (NN) is proposed for efficient storage as well as transmission of medical images. Primarily, medical images are preprocessed using median filter to suppress noisy data and then decomposed into approximation and detailed coefficients using wavelet transform. Subsequently, detailed coefficients are filtered with proposed thresholding technique. Both approximation and detailed coefficients are divided into sub matrix with the size of n x n and used as input to the NN to perform compression. The image compression performance of the proposed method is evaluated by computing peak signal to noise ratio, compression ratio and storage space and compared with prevailing methods to prove its effectiveness. The empirical findings reveal that the proposed method provides best performance compared to the former methods taken for comparison.

articleTitle: Design of Regenerative Chatter Stability Detection System in Machine Tool Cutting based on Computer Vision and SAR Image
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The thesis starts with the analysis of the stability of the regenerative cutting chatter system. Based on the SAR image algorithm, the machine is processed in the processing steps of image denoising, image segmentation, target detection and recognition, focusing on the limit cutting width and random bed spindle speed W. The main factors affecting the stability of the machine tool cutting system are systematically analyzed, including the dynamic parameters of the main vibration system, and a SAR image segmentation method based on the global Maxflow neighborhood growth algorithm is proposed, which combines the texture and boundary information In combination, using C# as the development tool, designed a turning chatter stability limit prediction software, and systematically introduced the function realization and use method of the software.

articleTitle: Tumor Image Identification based on DWT and PNN Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Medical specialists have a hard time finding tumors in the ground truth image of the brain because the intensity, magnitude, position, distinction, and shape of the tumors vary between images. Other reasons include different acquisition methods, modalities, and finally the age of the affected patient. The primary diagnosis of Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) brain image is regularly termed as a brain injury. The cells can be tumorous or non-tumorous. The presence of abnormal tumors, sources the stress in the inner part of the infected part to intensify. The aforementioned situation results in damage to the sensitive brain image cells, resulting in life-threatening situations. It is challenging to identify abnormalities in the human brain using conventional imaging tools. MRI can differentiate and clarify the network architectural section of the brain image. This proposed work deliberates on noise reduction approaches, grey-level cooccurrence matrix feature extraction, and Discrete Wavelet Transform based tumor imaged area growth segmentation to simplify and improve values. Morphological filtering was used to remove any potential noise after segmentation. MRI data were used to train and assess a Probabilistic Neural Network classifier for identifying infected parts. The proposed method was tested and trained brain MRI images, were more accurate in discriminating between usual and infected brain MR images in the studies, demonstrating its utility.

articleTitle: Optimization of an Intelligent and Survey Robot for Inspection and Fault Diagnosis Mechanism in the Manufacturing Sector
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Presently most of the robots do repeat works or jobs which are considered as more difficult for human beings. Also, it is very dangerous for the workers to work in the hazardous environments which can be overcome by industrial robots. Intelligent bots can sense, learn, monitor, control, and can-do high-quality work continuously without breaks. This action was done by merging the human benefits and physical systems with intelligent cyber systems. To monitor and detect the faults in the manufacturing industries a blue tooth based intelligent inspection robot is designed in this paper. The robot’s control action is developed by block designer of MIT app-inventor in the android phone along with blue-tooth connection, and the robot can be operated and controlled by phone. This smart inspection-robot has four wheels which can move and inspect the manufacturing products inside the factories. The proposed robot has camera and is connected through blue tooth. The speed and position of the robot are inserted into the processor which controls the robot smoothly and automatically. First the controller application is developed by designer and block editor of MIT app inventor. Then it is installed on the android phone. Now the Arduino UNO-microcontroller with blue tooth is entrenched with android application will communicate with the robot and finds the fault accurately by personal image classifier. The personal image classifier will detect the cracks and holes in big and small size, also detects corrosion and indicate the damages percentage in any manufactured products which is very difficult or cannot view through human naked eyes. So, the reviewer sends the workers immediately to the correct place and the damages can be repaired at low cost at right time. At last, the proposed mobile robot has been controlled and are performed and success experimentally of the coordination between the Android application and the mobile robot are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Decentralized Storage Algorithm of Medical Courses on Cloud Platform in Colleges Under the Background of O2O Integration
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: With the development of computer and Internet technology, the current cloud computing platform can be more and more widely used, and the current cloud computing platform has begun to develop in the direction of decentralization, so it is necessary to study the implementation method of this technology. And use the configuration management function of the cloud computing platform to automate its management and transformation, and cooperate with the high-availability decentralized software architecture to achieve the first main design goal proposed at the beginning of this paper, that is, the self-management of the system. This paper proposes a cloud The realization method of the decentralized storage algorithm of the platform medical nursing course to meet the current and future development requirements of cloud computing.
